items.title: DeepSeek今天正式漲價 採用峰谷定價
items.title_en: DeepSeek Raises Prices Today, Implements Peak‑Off‑Peak Pricing
paras: 近日DeepSeek官方宣布對DeepSeek API價格進行更新調整，並採用峰谷定價，空閒時段價格為高峰時段價格的一半，新價格已於17日（周一）零時正式生效。
根據DeepSeek的最新定價，對於DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型，百萬tokens輸入（緩存命中）空閒時段價格為人民幣（下同）0.05元，高峰時段價格0.1元；百萬tokens輸入（緩存未命中）空閒時段價格1.5元，高峰時段3元；百萬tokens輸出空閒時段價格4.5元，高峰時段價格9元。
對於DeepSeek-V4-Pro模型，百萬tokens輸入（緩存命中）空閒時段價格為0.15元，高峰時段價格0.3元；百萬tokens輸入（緩存未命中）空閒時段價格4.5元，高峰時段9元；百萬tokens輸出空閒時段價格13.5元，高峰時段價格27元。
高峰時段為台灣時間9:00～12:00、14:00～18:00，其餘為空閒時段。
據《觀察者網》報導，業界人士將DeepSeek引入峰谷定價機制，解讀為其在算力資源稀缺背景下的標準化調度工具，漲價決定則被分析理解為算力成本高漲壓力下的應對策略。
受算力供需影響，近半年來多家中國國產大模型服務商都採取了漲價、調整付費模式等舉措。例如，智譜執行長張鵬4月表示，2026年第一季智譜API調用定價提升83%。豆包專業版於6月也宣布，採用標準/加強/高級套餐連續包月分別為68元、200元、500元三級階梯定價模式。
paras_en: DeepSeek announced a price update for its API, introducing a peak‑off‑peak model where the off‑peak rate is half the peak rate. The new pricing took effect at midnight on Monday the 17th.

Under the new rates for the DeepSeek‑V4‑Flash model, the off‑peak price for cached input is RMB 0.05 per million tokens and RMB 0.10 during peak hours; uncached input costs RMB 1.5 off‑peak and RMB 3.0 peak; output costs RMB 4.5 off‑peak and RMB 9.0 peak.
For the DeepSeek‑V4‑Pro model, cached input is priced at RMB 0.15 off‑peak and RMB 0.30 peak; uncached input is RMB 4.5 off‑peak and RMB 9.0 peak; output is RMB 13.5 off‑peak and RMB 27.0 peak.
Peak hours are defined as 09:00‑12:00 and 14:00‑18:00 Taiwan time, with all other times considered off‑peak.

According to Observer.com, industry insiders view DeepSeek’s adoption of peak‑off‑peak pricing as a standardized scheduling tool amid scarce compute resources, and see the price hike as a response to rising compute‑cost pressures.

Due to compute supply‑demand dynamics, several Chinese domestic large‑model providers have raised prices or altered payment models in the past six months. For example, Zhipu CEO Zhang Peng said in April that Zhipu API pricing would increase by 83% in Q1 2026, and Doubao’s professional tier announced in June a three‑tier monthly plan of RMB 68, 200 and 500 for standard, enhanced and premium packages.

items.title: 支出正在轉化為收益？華爾街科技巨頭AI投資變現
items.title_en: Is Spending Turning into Profit? Wall Street Tech Giants' AI Investment Begins to Bear Fruit
paras: 隨著股市重回歷史新高，華爾街策略師觀察到大型科技公司在人工智慧(AI)領域的巨額投資正開始產生回報，特別是擁有龐大雲端業務的「超大規模業者」(hyperscalers)。
Truist 首席投資策略師 Keith Lerner 指出，「支出正在引領獲利」，這顯示出 AI 投資的變現能力正逐步顯現。
基於強勁的盈餘展望與雲端需求，摩根大通已將標普 500 指數的目標價從 7,800 點調升至 8,000 點。

在各大科技巨頭中，雲端業務的表現尤為亮眼。微軟(MSFT-US)的 Azure 業務年銷售額首次突破 1,000 億美元，帶動其雲端營收創下歷史紀錄，並預計本季將進一步加速成長。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下的 AWS 成長率達到 36.7%，創下 18 季以來的最快增速。Alphabet (GOOGL-US)的雲端業務同樣呈現爆發式成長，而 Meta (META-US)甚至在考慮出租其部分的計算能力。
所有這些承諾都需要更多投資，根據美銀研究報告，前四大雲端服務商的積壓訂單金額已超過 2.3 兆美元，較第一季增長 16%。
為應對強勁需求，Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟和 Meta 今年預計將集體投入約 7,250 億至 7,600 億美元的資本支出用於建構 AI 基礎設施。
摩根大通策略師 Dubravko Lakos-Bujas 指出，雖然多數業者的自由現金流在 2027 財年可能仍為負值，但其業務增長速度已超過支出增長，這是一個需求開始追上龐大資本支出的信號。分析師預測，貨幣化進程可能開始比支出增長更快，這將支撐未來的營收成長並緩解投資者對投資報酬率(ROIC)的疑慮。
此外，Sevens Report Research 創辦人 Tom Essaye 認為，在半導體和記憶體之後，雲端容量將成為 AI 數據建設的下一個瓶頸。
paras_en: As the stock market returns to historical highs, Wall Street strategists have observed that large tech companies' massive investments in artificial intelligence (AI) are starting to yield returns, particularly among "hyperscalers" with significant cloud businesses.
Truist Chief Investment Strategist Keith Lerner notes that "spending is leading to profits," indicating that the payback potential of AI investments is gradually emerging.
Based on strong earnings outlooks and cloud demand, JPMorgan has raised its target price for the S&P 500 index to 8,000 from 7,800.

Among the major tech giants, cloud businesses have shone particularly brightly. Microsoft's (MSFT-US) Azure business has surpassed $100 billion in annual sales for the first time, driving its cloud revenue to a historical record and expected to accelerate further this quarter. Amazon's (AMZN-US) AWS growth rate reached 36.7%, the fastest pace in 18 quarters. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) cloud business has also shown explosive growth, while Meta (META-US) is even considering renting out some of its computing capacity.

All these commitments require more investment, according to a Goldman Sachs report, which found that the accumulated backlogged orders of the top four cloud service providers have exceeded $230 billion, up 16% from the first quarter.
To meet the strong demand, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta are expected to collectively invest around $725 billion to $760 billion in capital expenditures to build AI infrastructure this year.

JPMorgan strategist Dubravko Lakos-Bujas notes that while most companies' free cash flow may still be negative in the 2027 fiscal year, their business growth rate has already surpassed spending growth, signaling that demand is catching up with massive capital expenditures. Analysts predict that the monetization process may begin to outpace spending growth, supporting future revenue growth and alleviating concerns about return on investment (ROIC).
Furthermore, Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye believes that cloud capacity will become the next bottleneck in AI data construction, following semiconductors and memory.

items.title: 伊朗懸賞3萬美元「殺美軍」！女性出手獎金翻倍
paras: 伊朗軍方週日（16日）宣布，將提供最高3萬美元（約新台幣96萬）的獎金，鼓勵民眾殺死或俘虜美國軍人；若由女性完成相關行動，獎金將提高至兩倍。伊朗陸軍司令哈塔米（Amir Hatami）表示，這項計畫是在收到「大量請求」後制定。
根據《南華早報》引述伊朗國營通訊社《IRNA》報導，哈塔米表示：「任何殺死或俘虜並將入侵的美國軍事人員交給伊朗方面的人，都將獲得伊朗伊斯蘭共和國陸軍提供的相當於3萬美元或50億伊朗土曼（Iranian toman）的獎勵。」
土曼是伊朗民間使用的貨幣單位，1土曼相當於1萬伊朗里亞爾。
他還表示：「勇敢的伊朗女性若完成這類行動，將獲得雙倍獎勵。」
哈塔米同時重申伊朗要求美國撤出中東的立場，並表示美軍「不再獲准進入波斯灣、阿曼灣或荷姆茲海峽」。
目前已知在這場中東戰爭期間，美軍並未在伊朗境內部署地面部隊，唯一例外是4月為救援一名墜落的美軍飛行員而執行的行動。
戰事爆發一個多月後，美軍展開大規模救援行動，試圖救出一架F-15戰機的武器系統官。當時約有200名美軍人員及超過170架軍機投入行動，爭取在伊朗部隊找到這名軍人之前將其救出。
救援行動期間，伊朗部隊擊傷一架A-10攻擊機，該機最終在友軍控制區域棄置。
據報導，美軍也放棄並摧毀了部分參與這次任務的軍機，其中包括一架C-130運輸機。
經過近40天的戰鬥後，戰事於4月透過停火暫時告一段落，雙方隨後在6月建立和平談判框架，但該框架最終宣告破裂。
此後，伊朗與美國仍不時發生交火，戰鬥主要集中在伊朗南部以及荷姆茲海峽周邊。
雙方透過中間人維持間接接觸，但目前幾乎看不到外交取得突破的跡象。伊朗也提出重新開放荷姆茲海峽的條件，包括要求賠償戰爭造成的損失。
自戰爭爆發以來，共有17名美軍人員死亡，最近一批死亡事件發生於7月。這些人員全部是在伊朗境外喪生，包括約旦與伊拉克等國家。

items.title: 〈焦點股〉凌巨Q2財報未如期申報 股價跳空鎖跌停
items.title_en: Ling Jyu's Q2 Financial Report Fails to Meet Deadline, Stock Price Plummets
paras: 中小尺寸凌巨(8105-TW)因董事會僅有1人，導致第二季財報無法如期申報，今(17)日股價開盤即跳空跌停鎖住。
證交所上周五公告，本國上市公司(不含金融保險公司)應於14日完成年第二季財務報告申報，本次應申報的 961 家公司中，除凌巨無法如期申報外，其餘 960 家均已順利完成作業。
據了解，凌巨董事會原有6席董事及3席獨董，但自6月25日股東會解任1席董事，隔日法人董事日商凸版控股因轉讓凌巨私募股權，4席法人董事及代表人當然解任，3名獨董也於7月8日至13日相繼辭任，導致董事會僅剩1人。
凌巨表示，由於目前現任董事僅有1人，能否組成董事會議決第二季財報有疑義，公司也曾於7月17日去函證期局申請延長財務報告公告申報期限，但未獲核准展延；凌巨也擬於8月24日召開股東臨時會，全面改選董事。
paras_en: Ling Jyu (8105-TW), a small to medium-sized company, has only one board member, resulting in its inability to submit its Q2 financial report on time. As a result, its stock price plummeted and was locked at the lower limit on the 17th.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced last Friday that domestic listed companies (excluding financial and insurance companies) should have completed their second-quarter financial report submissions by the 14th. Among the 961 companies that were required to submit reports, all 960 companies except Ling Jyu have completed the process.

It is understood that Ling Jyu's board of directors originally had six seats and three independent directors. However, after the shareholders' meeting on June 25, one director was removed, and the next day, the corporate director, Toppan Inc., transferred Ling Jyu's private placement shares, resulting in the removal of four corporate directors and their representatives. The three independent directors also resigned between July 8 and 13, leaving only one director on the board.

Ling Jyu stated that since there is currently only one director, there is uncertainty about whether the board can convene to decide on the Q2 financial report. The company had applied to the Financial Supervisory Commission to extend the deadline for submitting the financial report on July 17 but was not approved. Ling Jyu plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on August 24 to fully elect new directors.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉汎瑋Q2獲利年增翻倍 激勵股價亮燈飆漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Panwei Q2 Profit Doubles YoY, Fueling a Limit‑Up Surge
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料(6967-TW)今(2026)年第2季稅後純益為4,100萬元、年增105.9％，稅後每股純益為1.66元，汎瑋第2季營運成長受惠AI伺服器、高效能運算(HPC)及高階電子應用需求持續升級，在業績助攻下，今(17)日開高跳空後迅速攻上漲停價75.6元，也創一個月以來新高價。
瑋受惠AI伺服器、高階電子功能性材料布局逐步發揮效益，公司近年持續進行產品結構優化，第2季合併營收4.41億元、季增16.31％、年增28.22％；累計上半年合併營收達8.2億元、年增28.43％，營業利益9,500萬元，年增61.62％、稅後純益6,700萬元、年增88.38％，EPS為 2.73元，上半年已賺進去(2025)年全年的68％。
汎瑋表示，在公司近年持續進行產品結構優化下，第2季AI伺服器、電動車、工業電腦等高附加價值應用合計占營收比重達27.05％，較去(2025)年同期增加151.51個百分點，AI伺服器相關應用占比提升至14.61％，年增480.54百分點；電動車及工業電腦等應用占比亦同步提升。
此外，汎瑋隨高利基型應用需求持續擴大，高毛利產品出貨比重逐步提高，不僅推升整體營收成長，也有助於改善產品組合與獲利結構，帶動第2季毛利率達28.74％、營益率13.65％，分別較去年同期增加2.87個百分點及4.36個百分點。
汎瑋強調，未來隨高利基、高附加價值應用占比逐步提升，汎瑋亦逐步深化高階利基市場布局，優化產品結構與獲利組合，進一步建立中長期穩定成長的營運基礎。
paras_en: Electronic functional materials maker Panwei Materials (6967‑TW) reported Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$41 million, up 105.9% year‑on‑year, or NT$1.66 earnings per share. The company’s Q2 growth was driven by continued upgrades in AI server, high‑performance computing (HPC) and high‑end electronic applications. On the day (the 17th), the stock opened with a high gap and quickly surged to the limit‑up price of NT$75.6, a one‑month high.

Benefiting from its AI server and high‑end electronic functional material positioning, Panwei has been optimizing its product mix in recent years. In Q2, consolidated revenue reached NT$441 million, up 16.31% quarter‑on‑quarter and 28.22% year‑on‑year. For the first half of the year, consolidated revenue totaled NT$820 million, a 28.43% increase YoY, with operating profit of NT$95 million (up 61.62% YoY) and after‑tax net profit of NT$67 million (up 88.38% YoY), yielding EPS of NT$2.73 – already accounting for 68% of the full‑year 2025 target.

Panwei said that, thanks to ongoing product‑mix optimization, high‑value‑added applications such as AI servers, electric vehicles and industrial PCs accounted for 27.05% of Q2 revenue, a jump of 151.51 percentage points from the same quarter in 2025. AI‑server‑related sales rose to 14.61% of revenue, up 480.54 percentage points YoY, while EV and industrial‑PC applications also saw their shares increase.

Moreover, as demand for high‑margin niche applications continues to expand, the proportion of high‑gross‑margin product shipments has risen, boosting overall revenue growth and improving the product mix and profit structure. This lifted Q2 gross‑margin to 28.74% and operating‑margin to 13.65%, up 2.87 and 4.36 percentage points respectively versus the prior year.

Panwei emphasized that as the share of high‑margin, high‑value‑added applications keeps rising, the company will further deepen its presence in premium niche markets, refine its product structure and profit mix, and build a stable, medium‑to‑long‑term growth foundation.

items.title: 公股福利標竿！兆豐加碼8千元國旅補助 員工每年爽領1.7萬元旅補
items.title_en: Public‑Sector Welfare Benchmark! Mega Bank Boosts Domestic Travel Subsidy by NT$8,000, Giving Employees Up to NT$17,000 in Travel Allowances Each Year
paras: 兆豐銀行為感謝員工的投入與辛勞，長期提撥一定比率營收作為職工福利委員會福利金，支持辦理各項員工福利活動。今年特別加碼「國旅二日遊8000元補助專案」，結合原有每年4000元年度旅遊補助及5000元員工自強活動補助，每位員工年度旅遊及活動總額可高達1萬7000元，福利高居公股銀行最優。兆豐銀行希望以實際行動照顧員工身心健康，鼓勵同仁兼顧工作與生活品質，同時支持國內觀光及旅宿產業發展，預估可創造上億元國旅商機。

兆豐銀行表示，員工的幸福感是企業持續成長的重要力量，除了在工作上提供支持與發展機會，也希望同仁能在忙碌之餘擁有更多與家人相處、放鬆充電的時光。透過此次國旅補助，鼓勵同仁利用假期充實身心，與家人朋友一同探索台灣各地的自然風光、品嘗在地美食，在旅行中創造美好回憶。隨同仁走訪各地，也將帶動住宿、餐飲、交通及地方特色商家消費，讓員工福利不僅成為照顧同仁的心意，更為在地觀光與經濟發展注入溫暖活力，形成共好的正向循環。
除本次加碼方案，兆豐銀行每年另補助每位員工5000元，委由職工福利委員會辦理員工自強活動，安排數十條國內旅遊路線供員工自行選擇，展現兆豐銀行在薪酬制度之外，持續強化員工休閒、健康及家庭生活支持的用心。
展望未來，兆豐銀行將持續傾聽員工需求，從薪酬福利、健康照護、家庭支持、教育訓練及休閒活動等面向，規劃更貼近同仁生活與職涯發展需求的福利措施。希望讓每位員工在投入工作的同時，也能兼顧身心健康與家庭生活，在充滿支持與關懷的環境中安心工作、持續成長，共同打造幸福友善職場，為企業永續發展注入穩健動能。
paras_en: Mega Bank, to thank employees for their dedication and hard work, has long set aside a fixed percentage of revenue for the staff welfare committee’s benefit fund, supporting a range of employee‑benefit activities. This year it is adding a special “Two‑Day Domestic Travel NT$8,000 Subsidy Program,” which combines the existing NT$4,000 annual travel allowance and the NT$5,000 employee self‑development activity grant, allowing each employee to receive up to NT$17,000 in total travel‑related benefits annually – the highest among publicly‑owned banks. Mega Bank hopes that concrete actions will look after employees’ physical and mental health, encourage a balance between work and quality of life, and at the same time support the development of the domestic tourism and hospitality sectors, which is estimated to generate over NT$100 million in travel business.

Mega Bank says employee happiness is a key driver of the company’s sustained growth. In addition to providing support and development opportunities at work, it wants staff to have more time to relax and spend with family amid their busy schedules. Through this travel subsidy, the bank encourages employees to use their leave to recharge, explore Taiwan’s natural scenery, and taste local cuisine together with family and friends, creating wonderful memories. As employees travel around the country, they will also stimulate spending on accommodation, dining, transportation and local specialty merchants, turning the welfare benefit into not only a gesture of care for staff but also a boost to local tourism and economic development, creating a positive, mutually‑beneficial cycle.

Beyond this added program, Mega Bank also provides each employee with a NT$5,000 annual grant managed by the staff welfare committee for self‑development activities, offering dozens of domestic travel itineraries for employees to choose from. This demonstrates the bank’s commitment, beyond compensation, to continuously strengthen support for employees’ leisure, health and family life.

Looking ahead, Mega Bank will keep listening to employee needs and design welfare measures that are closely aligned with staff’s lives and career development, covering compensation, health care, family support, education and training, and recreational activities. The goal is to enable every employee to balance work, well‑being and family life in a supportive and caring environment, fostering a happy, friendly workplace that injects steady momentum into the company’s sustainable growth.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉大同Q2擺脫虧損法說前股價暖身 價量齊揚
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Datong Q2 Breaks Losses, Prepares for Earnings Call
paras: 大同(2371-TW)第二季受惠中國華映案回沖效益挹注，第二季業外進補，帶動稅後純益達20.15億元，轉虧為盈，激勵大同今(17)日價量齊揚。此外，大同明(18)日將召開法說會，屆時將釋出最新市況與展望。
大同今天早盤以26.8元開高走高，盤中最高漲至27.25元，漲幅超過3%，力拚收復季線，成交量超過6000張。三大法人連續3個交易日買超，上周合計買超3876張。
大同第二季營收130.14億元，季增13.28%，年增0.05%；毛利率17.37%，季增0.94個百分點，年減0.09個百分點；營益率5.26%，季增1.49個百分點，年減0.89個百分點；稅後純益20.15億元，擺脫連2季虧損，年增3.31倍，每股純益0.96元。
大同累計上半年營收245.02億元，年增4.03%；毛利率16.93%，年減0.96個百分點；營益率4.56%，年減0.51個百分點；稅後純益19.16億元，年增1.48倍，每股純益0.91元。
法人指出，若中國法院持續處置華映百慕大持股，大同有望繼續認列回沖利益，可望進一步改善財務狀況。本業方面，大同指出，電力事業群客戶交貨排程順利，國內外出貨皆順暢，其中，重電事業表現最為突出。
paras_en: Datong (2371-TW) benefited from the China Huaming case reversal in the second quarter, with non-operating income injection, resulting in a net profit of NT$2.015 billion, turning a loss into a profit, and driving Datong's stock price to surge today (17th).

Datong's stock price rose sharply in the morning session, opening at NT$26.8 and reaching a high of NT$27.25, with a gain of over 3%, and exceeding 6,000 shares traded. Institutional investors have been buying for three consecutive trading days, with a total of 3,876 shares bought last week.

Datong's second-quarter revenue reached NT$13.014 billion, up 13.28% from the previous quarter and 0.05% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 17.37%, up 0.94 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 0.09 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 5.26%, up 1.49 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 0.89 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$2.015 billion, breaking a two-quarter loss streak and up 3.31 times from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.96.

Datong's cumulative revenue for the first half of the year reached NT$24.502 billion, up 4.03% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 16.93%, down 0.96 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 4.56%, down 0.51 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$1.916 billion, up 1.48 times from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.91.

Institutional investors pointed out that if the Chinese court continues to handle the Huaming case in Bermuda, Datong may be able to continue recognizing reversal benefits, which could further improve its financial situation. In terms of its main business, Datong stated that its power business group's customer delivery schedule has been smooth, with both domestic and foreign shipments proceeding smoothly, with the heavy power business performing the most outstandingly.

items.title: 「木頭姐」Q2大砍輝達、AMD、台積電！砸4.43億美元押SpaceX
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）今年第二季投資組合出現明顯轉向，除了新建倉SpaceX(SPCX-US) 並押注太空產業，也同步加碼人工智慧（AI）與生技領域，另一方面則減持輝達(NVDA-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 及台積電(2330-TW) 等半導體股，顯示其「顛覆性創新」投資策略正從AI硬體進一步轉向太空、醫療及金融科技等領域。
根據相關持倉資料，ARK 2026年第2季持倉總市值達154.56億美元，較第1季的128.59億美元增加20.2%；持倉標的由182檔增加至189檔，前十大持股占比則從40.03%降至約36%。基金第2季業績達29.06%。
其中最受矚目的操作，是ARK新建倉SpaceX。旗下ETF合計買進約329萬股，投入約4.43億美元，使SpaceX一舉成為第2季前十大持股之一，占整體持倉約2.87%。
SpaceX此次進入ARK投資組合，被視為伍德押注太空經濟的重要訊號。相關資料顯示，ARK在SpaceX IPO時進場，並將太空運輸及Starlink衛星網路視為未來成長的重要來源。
伍德長期看好SpaceX，並曾將其形容為可能成為人類歷史上最重要的企業之一。ARK內部模型對SpaceX 2030年的估值則設定不同情境，其中基準情境為2.5兆美元、樂觀情境為3.1兆美元、悲觀情境為1.7兆美元。
SpaceX也並非ARK唯一押注的太空相關標的。第2季ARK同時加碼Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) ，以及Joby Aviation Inc(JOBY-US) 、Archer Aviation(ACHR-US) 等電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）公司，進一步擴大太空與新型交通工具的配置。
儘管投資重心出現變化，特斯拉仍是ARK第2季第一大持股，持股市值約10.5億美元，占整體投資組合6.8%。
不過，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的組合占比已從第1季的8.16%進一步降至6.8%。資料顯示，ARK第2季持有特斯拉約276萬股，持股數量較前季下降約2.5%。
特斯拉自2019年以來已連續27個季度成為ARK第一大持股，但近幾季其在整體投資組合中的比重持續降低。相較之下，SpaceX此次進場，顯示伍德正將部分投資重心延伸至太空領域。

生技成為另一大加碼方向

除了太空，ARK第2季也明顯增加生技相關持股，其中CRISPR治療(CRSP-US) 及Tempus AI(TEM-US) 尤為突出。
CRISPR治療第2季持股增加約7.5%，持倉市值約5.7億美元，占比3.69%，躍居ARK第二大持股。
Tempus AI則是ARK第2季增持幅度最大的主要持股之一，持股數量增加約27%，持倉市值約5.4億美元，占比3.49%。
ARK同時持有Beam Therapeutics Inc(BEAM-US) 等基因編輯公司。從整體操作來看，伍德持續將AI與生物科技結合視為重要投資方向，押注AI在醫療資料、精準醫療及基因技術等領域的應用。

半導體持股全面減碼　輝達減持逾17%

與生技、太空形成鮮明對比的是，ARK第2季對半導體相關持股進行減碼。
超微半導體第2季持股減少約5%，持倉市值約5.2億美元，占比3.36%，由第1季第二大持股位置下滑。
輝達的減持幅度更為明顯，第2季持股減少17.47%。台積電持股則減少16.15%。
此外，ARK第2季也新建倉博通(AVGO-US) ，並買進AI晶片業者Cerebras，顯示其並非全面退出AI硬體，而是在AI晶片領域進行持股調整。
從整體配置來看，伍德正在降低部分成熟半導體公司的持股，同時尋找ASIC、AI軟體及其他新型運算架構的投資機會。

金融科技加碼　Robinhood、Circle受青睞

金融科技與加密貨幣也是ARK第2季的另一個加碼方向。
Robinhood(HOOD-US) 第2季持股增加約24.9%，持倉市值達5億美元，占比3.24%，躍居前十大持股第6名。
Circle(CRCL-US) 則增持約9.1%，持倉市值約4.8億美元，占比3.11%。ARK持有的另一項主要加密相關資產Coinbase(COIN-US) ，則減持約7%。
此外，ARK也增加對Bullish(BLSH-US) 等加密貨幣交易平台的配置，反映伍德仍將區塊鏈、加密金融及相關金融服務視為具顛覆潛力的投資領域。

Meta近乎退出　Google反成AI布局標的

大型科技股方面，Meta(META-US) 成為ARK第2季明顯減碼的標的之一。
Meta在第1季已遭減持48.42%，當時持倉市值約8,800萬美元，占比0.68%，第2季則進一步接近清倉或僅留下極小部位。
相較之下，ARK在第1季大幅增加Google(GOOGL-US) 持股，增持幅度達31.97%，第2季也持續加碼。這顯示伍德在大型科技股中的配置也出現差異化，對AI搜尋等領域的布局相對受到重視。

組合更加分散　但高波動特性仍在

從整體持倉來看，ARK第2季共有189檔標的，前十大持股約占36%，前三大持股則約占13.85%，整體組合相較第1季更加分散。
目前前十大持股依序包括特斯拉、CRISPR治療、超微半導體、Tempus AI、Shopify(SHOP-US) 、Robinhood、Palantir(PLTR-US) 、Circle、SpaceX及Coinbase。
從產業配置來看，AI、生技與基因技術、金融科技與區塊鏈、太空探索、機器人及能源儲存等仍是ARK布局的主要創新主題。
伍德此次調整的核心特徵，在於降低部分AI硬體及成熟晶片標的的配置，同時將資金轉向SpaceX、生技、金融科技與新型交通等領域。這也延續ARK長期尋找下一個高成長創新平台的投資策略。
不過，這類高成長標的本身也伴隨較高波動與不確定性。SpaceX、生技公司及加密金融相關企業均仍處於快速發展階段，因此ARK第2季近30%的單季報酬，也與其集中布局高成長創新題材的投資風格密切相關。

items.title: 〈焦點股〉凌巨Q2財報未如期申報 股價跳空鎖跌停
items.title_en: Ling Jyu's Q2 Financial Report Fails to Meet Deadline, Stock Price Plummets
paras: 中小尺寸凌巨(8105-TW)因董事會僅有1人，導致第二季財報無法如期申報，今(17)日股價開盤即跳空跌停鎖住。
證交所上周五公告，本國上市公司(不含金融保險公司)應於14日完成年第二季財務報告申報，本次應申報的 961 家公司中，除凌巨無法如期申報外，其餘 960 家均已順利完成作業。
據了解，凌巨董事會原有6席董事及3席獨董，但自6月25日股東會解任1席董事，隔日法人董事日商凸版控股因轉讓凌巨私募股權，4席法人董事及代表人當然解任，3名獨董也於7月8日至13日相繼辭任，導致董事會僅剩1人。
凌巨表示，由於目前現任董事僅有1人，能否組成董事會議決第二季財報有疑義，公司也曾於7月17日去函證期局申請延長財務報告公告申報期限，但未獲核准展延；凌巨也擬於8月24日召開股東臨時會，全面改選董事。
paras_en: Ling Jyu (8105-TW), a small to medium-sized company, has only one board member, resulting in its inability to submit its Q2 financial report on time. As a result, its stock price plummeted and was locked at the lower limit on the 17th.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced last Friday that domestic listed companies (excluding financial and insurance companies) should have completed their second-quarter financial report submissions by the 14th. Among the 961 companies that were required to submit reports, all 960 companies except Ling Jyu have completed the process.

It is understood that Ling Jyu's board of directors originally had six seats and three independent directors. However, after the shareholders' meeting on June 25, one director was removed, and the next day, the corporate director, Toppan Inc., transferred Ling Jyu's private placement shares, resulting in the removal of four corporate directors and their representatives. The three independent directors also resigned between July 8 and 13, leaving only one director on the board.

Ling Jyu stated that since there is currently only one director, there is uncertainty about whether the board can convene to decide on the Q2 financial report. The company had applied to the Financial Supervisory Commission to extend the deadline for submitting the financial report on July 17 but was not approved. Ling Jyu plans to hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on August 24 to fully elect new directors.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉汎瑋Q2獲利年增翻倍 激勵股價亮燈飆漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Panwei Q2 Profit Doubles YoY, Fueling a Limit‑Up Surge
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料(6967-TW)今(2026)年第2季稅後純益為4,100萬元、年增105.9％，稅後每股純益為1.66元，汎瑋第2季營運成長受惠AI伺服器、高效能運算(HPC)及高階電子應用需求持續升級，在業績助攻下，今(17)日開高跳空後迅速攻上漲停價75.6元，也創一個月以來新高價。
瑋受惠AI伺服器、高階電子功能性材料布局逐步發揮效益，公司近年持續進行產品結構優化，第2季合併營收4.41億元、季增16.31％、年增28.22％；累計上半年合併營收達8.2億元、年增28.43％，營業利益9,500萬元，年增61.62％、稅後純益6,700萬元、年增88.38％，EPS為 2.73元，上半年已賺進去(2025)年全年的68％。
汎瑋表示，在公司近年持續進行產品結構優化下，第2季AI伺服器、電動車、工業電腦等高附加價值應用合計占營收比重達27.05％，較去(2025)年同期增加151.51個百分點，AI伺服器相關應用占比提升至14.61％，年增480.54百分點；電動車及工業電腦等應用占比亦同步提升。
此外，汎瑋隨高利基型應用需求持續擴大，高毛利產品出貨比重逐步提高，不僅推升整體營收成長，也有助於改善產品組合與獲利結構，帶動第2季毛利率達28.74％、營益率13.65％，分別較去年同期增加2.87個百分點及4.36個百分點。
汎瑋強調，未來隨高利基、高附加價值應用占比逐步提升，汎瑋亦逐步深化高階利基市場布局，優化產品結構與獲利組合，進一步建立中長期穩定成長的營運基礎。
paras_en: Electronic functional materials maker Panwei Materials (6967‑TW) reported Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$41 million, up 105.9% year‑on‑year, or NT$1.66 earnings per share. The company’s Q2 growth was driven by continued upgrades in AI server, high‑performance computing (HPC) and high‑end electronic applications. On the day (the 17th), the stock opened with a high gap and quickly surged to the limit‑up price of NT$75.6, a one‑month high.

Benefiting from its AI server and high‑end electronic functional material positioning, Panwei has been optimizing its product mix in recent years. In Q2, consolidated revenue reached NT$441 million, up 16.31% quarter‑on‑quarter and 28.22% year‑on‑year. For the first half of the year, consolidated revenue totaled NT$820 million, a 28.43% increase YoY, with operating profit of NT$95 million (up 61.62% YoY) and after‑tax net profit of NT$67 million (up 88.38% YoY), yielding EPS of NT$2.73 – already accounting for 68% of the full‑year 2025 target.

Panwei said that, thanks to ongoing product‑mix optimization, high‑value‑added applications such as AI servers, electric vehicles and industrial PCs accounted for 27.05% of Q2 revenue, a jump of 151.51 percentage points from the same quarter in 2025. AI‑server‑related sales rose to 14.61% of revenue, up 480.54 percentage points YoY, while EV and industrial‑PC applications also saw their shares increase.

Moreover, as demand for high‑margin niche applications continues to expand, the proportion of high‑gross‑margin product shipments has risen, boosting overall revenue growth and improving the product mix and profit structure. This lifted Q2 gross‑margin to 28.74% and operating‑margin to 13.65%, up 2.87 and 4.36 percentage points respectively versus the prior year.

Panwei emphasized that as the share of high‑margin, high‑value‑added applications keeps rising, the company will further deepen its presence in premium niche markets, refine its product structure and profit mix, and build a stable, medium‑to‑long‑term growth foundation.

paras: 根據FactSet最新調查，共10位分析師，對長榮航(2618-TW)提出目標價估值：中位數由46.25元上修至47.75元，調升幅度3.24%。其中最高估值52元，最低估值34.3元。
綜合評級 - 共有10位分析師給予長榮航(2618-TW)評價：積極樂觀7位、保持中立3位、保守悲觀0位。
長榮航(2618-TW)今(17日)收盤價為41.65元。近5日股價下跌10.14%，相關航 運 業近5日上漲0.91%，集中市場加權指數上漲3.58%，短期股價無明顯表現。
資料來源：Factset，數據僅供參考，不作為投資建議。
paras_en: According to FactSet's latest survey, 10 analysts have set target prices for EVA Air (2618-TW): the median value has been raised from 46.25 TWD to 47.75 TWD, with a 3.24% increase. The highest estimate is 52 TWD, while the lowest is 34.3 TWD.
Overall rating - 10 analysts have given EVA Air (2618-TW) ratings: 7 are optimistic, 3 are neutral, and 0 are pessimistic.

EVA Air (2618-TW) closed at 41.65 TWD on the 17th. Over the past 5 days, the stock price has fallen by 10.14%, while the related transportation industry has risen by 0.91%, and the weighted index has risen by 3.58%. The short-term stock price shows no significant trend.
Data source: Factset, for reference only, not for investment advice.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉大同Q2擺脫虧損法說前股價暖身 價量齊揚
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Datong Q2 Breaks Losses, Prepares for Earnings Call
paras: 大同(2371-TW)第二季受惠中國華映案回沖效益挹注，第二季業外進補，帶動稅後純益達20.15億元，轉虧為盈，激勵大同今(17)日價量齊揚。此外，大同明(18)日將召開法說會，屆時將釋出最新市況與展望。
大同今天早盤以26.8元開高走高，盤中最高漲至27.25元，漲幅超過3%，力拚收復季線，成交量超過6000張。三大法人連續3個交易日買超，上周合計買超3876張。
大同第二季營收130.14億元，季增13.28%，年增0.05%；毛利率17.37%，季增0.94個百分點，年減0.09個百分點；營益率5.26%，季增1.49個百分點，年減0.89個百分點；稅後純益20.15億元，擺脫連2季虧損，年增3.31倍，每股純益0.96元。
大同累計上半年營收245.02億元，年增4.03%；毛利率16.93%，年減0.96個百分點；營益率4.56%，年減0.51個百分點；稅後純益19.16億元，年增1.48倍，每股純益0.91元。
法人指出，若中國法院持續處置華映百慕大持股，大同有望繼續認列回沖利益，可望進一步改善財務狀況。本業方面，大同指出，電力事業群客戶交貨排程順利，國內外出貨皆順暢，其中，重電事業表現最為突出。
paras_en: Datong (2371-TW) benefited from the China Huaming case reversal in the second quarter, with non-operating income injection, resulting in a net profit of NT$2.015 billion, turning a loss into a profit, and driving Datong's stock price to surge today (17th).

Datong's stock price rose sharply in the morning session, opening at NT$26.8 and reaching a high of NT$27.25, with a gain of over 3%, and exceeding 6,000 shares traded. Institutional investors have been buying for three consecutive trading days, with a total of 3,876 shares bought last week.

Datong's second-quarter revenue reached NT$13.014 billion, up 13.28% from the previous quarter and 0.05% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 17.37%, up 0.94 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 0.09 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 5.26%, up 1.49 percentage points from the previous quarter and down 0.89 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$2.015 billion, breaking a two-quarter loss streak and up 3.31 times from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.96.

Datong's cumulative revenue for the first half of the year reached NT$24.502 billion, up 4.03% from the same period last year. Gross margin was 16.93%, down 0.96 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating margin was 4.56%, down 0.51 percentage points from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$1.916 billion, up 1.48 times from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.91.

Institutional investors pointed out that if the Chinese court continues to handle the Huaming case in Bermuda, Datong may be able to continue recognizing reversal benefits, which could further improve its financial situation. In terms of its main business, Datong stated that its power business group's customer delivery schedule has been smooth, with both domestic and foreign shipments proceeding smoothly, with the heavy power business performing the most outstandingly.

items.title: 〈房產〉六都預售屋市場結構重組 台北價量齊躍升 高雄交易量慘減半
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Six Metropolitan Areas Restructure Pre-sale Housing Market: Taipei Prices and Volume Surge, Kaohsiung Volume Halved
paras: 全台房市仍冰冷，但由房仲業者統計顯示，2026年1-6月的全台六都預售案交易案件，唯有台北市平交易量年增4.2%，交易價格上漲高達7%。而交易量萎縮最為嚴重的高雄，交易件數則呈現腰斬，下滑高達50.2%

中信房屋研展室彙整實價登錄資料，對比六都2025年上半年與2026年上半年預售屋市場表現，台北市平均房價上漲7%、交易量增加4.2%，新北市平均房價上漲4.4%、交易量減少5.5%，桃園市平均房價上漲2.4%、交易量減少21.6%，台中市平均房價上漲1.5、交易量減少24.9%，台南市平均房價上漲3.1%、交易量減少23.6%，高雄市平均房價上漲1.9%、交易量減少50.2%，整體而言，六都預售房價仍維持上行趨勢，成交量卻普遍下滑，僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的局面。
中信房屋研展室副理莊思敏指出，從六都數據來看，當前預售市場已從過去的熱絡行情，逐步轉向「價格有撐、交易量收斂」的格局。房價方面，在土地成本、營造成本仍處於高檔的情況下，建商讓利空間相對有限，因此價格並未出現修正。然而，在交易量方面，受到信用管制與房貸資金環境影響，市場觀望氣氛瀰漫，買方心態轉趨保守，購屋決策時間也相應拉長，進而使得市場成交動能受到壓抑，交易量同步走弱。
莊思敏示，六都中僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的態勢，主要是因為台北市寸土寸金、土地供給有限、新屋供不應求，加上住宅市場客群多元，除了自住需求之外，也有一定比例的資產配置及長期置產需求，因此即使整體市況降溫，台北市仍能展現相對穩健的韌性。
相較之下，桃園、台中、台南及高雄等地的預售屋交易量則出現了較為明顯的量縮，以上區域的新建案多集中於新興重劃區或蛋白區，雖具備重大建設、交通項目或產業進駐等長期利多，惟部分區塊的生活機能仍處於起步階段，而房價卻已超前反映未來願景，如今隨著市場回歸剛性需求，買方出手更加謹慎，追價意願大幅降低，交易量自然隨之縮減。
莊思敏表示，目前房市仍處於盤整期，建議消費者應保持理性，審慎評估自身需求和財務狀況，避免盲目追價。此外，由於交易量持續走低、建商資金周轉壓力加重，市面上偶有建商財務危機或工程延宕的消息出現，消費者在挑選預售案時，務必要多加留意建商口碑與履約能力，以降低交易風險。
paras_en: The nationwide housing market remains cold, but data from real‑estate agents shows that for pre‑sale projects in the six major cities during the first half of 2026, only Taipei City recorded a 4.2% year‑over‑year increase in transaction volume and a price jump of up to 7%. In Kaohsiung, where the decline was most severe, the number of transactions was cut in half, dropping 50.2%.

The research department of CTBC Real Estate compiled official transaction‑price data and compared the pre‑sale market performance of the six cities between the first half of 2025 and the first half of 2026. Taipei’s average price rose 7% with a 4.2% rise in volume; New Taipei’s average price rose 4.4% while volume fell 5.5%; Taoyuan’s average price rose 2.4% with volume down 21.6%; Taichung’s average price rose 1.5% with volume down 24.9%; Tainan’s average price rose 3.1% with volume down 23.6%; Kaohsiung’s average price rose 1.9% with volume down 50.2%. Overall, pre‑sale prices in the six cities kept climbing, but transaction volumes generally fell, with only Taipei showing a “price‑and‑volume increase” scenario.

Zhuang Simin, deputy manager of CTBC Real Estate’s research department, said that the data from the six cities indicate the pre‑sale market has shifted from a previously hot climate to a pattern of “prices holding up while transaction volume contracts.” With land and construction costs still high, developers have limited room to cut prices, so prices have not been corrected. However, transaction volume is being squeezed by credit controls and the mortgage funding environment, creating a pervasive wait‑and‑see mood. Buyers are becoming more conservative and taking longer to decide, which dampens market momentum and weakens volume.

Zhuang noted that only Taipei still shows a “price‑and‑volume increase” because the city’s land is extremely scarce, supply of new homes cannot meet demand, and the residential market serves a diverse clientele. Besides owner‑occupiers, there is a sizable segment of investors and long‑term property‑placement demand, so even as overall conditions cool, Taipei can still demonstrate relatively robust resilience.

In contrast, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung have seen a more pronounced contraction in pre‑sale transaction volume. New projects in these areas are largely concentrated in emerging redevelopment zones or “egg‑white” districts that, while promising major infrastructure, transport projects or industry entry in the long run, still have nascent living‑amenity infrastructure. Prices have already priced in future expectations, and as the market returns to rigid demand, buyers are far more cautious, their willingness to chase prices has dropped sharply, and transaction volume has naturally shrunk.

Zhuang said the housing market remains in a consolidation phase and advised consumers to stay rational, carefully assess their own needs and financial situation, and avoid blindly chasing prices. Moreover, as transaction volumes continue to fall and developers face tighter cash flow, occasional news of developer financial distress or project delays emerges. Buyers should therefore pay close attention to a developer’s reputation and ability to fulfill contracts when selecting pre‑sale projects, to reduce transaction risk.

items.title: 支出正在轉化為收益？華爾街科技巨頭AI投資變現
items.title_en: Is Spending Turning into Profit? Wall Street Tech Giants' AI Investment Begins to Bear Fruit
paras: 隨著股市重回歷史新高，華爾街策略師觀察到大型科技公司在人工智慧(AI)領域的巨額投資正開始產生回報，特別是擁有龐大雲端業務的「超大規模業者」(hyperscalers)。
Truist 首席投資策略師 Keith Lerner 指出，「支出正在引領獲利」，這顯示出 AI 投資的變現能力正逐步顯現。
基於強勁的盈餘展望與雲端需求，摩根大通已將標普 500 指數的目標價從 7,800 點調升至 8,000 點。

在各大科技巨頭中，雲端業務的表現尤為亮眼。微軟(MSFT-US)的 Azure 業務年銷售額首次突破 1,000 億美元，帶動其雲端營收創下歷史紀錄，並預計本季將進一步加速成長。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下的 AWS 成長率達到 36.7%，創下 18 季以來的最快增速。Alphabet (GOOGL-US)的雲端業務同樣呈現爆發式成長，而 Meta (META-US)甚至在考慮出租其部分的計算能力。
所有這些承諾都需要更多投資，根據美銀研究報告，前四大雲端服務商的積壓訂單金額已超過 2.3 兆美元，較第一季增長 16%。
為應對強勁需求，Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟和 Meta 今年預計將集體投入約 7,250 億至 7,600 億美元的資本支出用於建構 AI 基礎設施。
摩根大通策略師 Dubravko Lakos-Bujas 指出，雖然多數業者的自由現金流在 2027 財年可能仍為負值，但其業務增長速度已超過支出增長，這是一個需求開始追上龐大資本支出的信號。分析師預測，貨幣化進程可能開始比支出增長更快，這將支撐未來的營收成長並緩解投資者對投資報酬率(ROIC)的疑慮。
此外，Sevens Report Research 創辦人 Tom Essaye 認為，在半導體和記憶體之後，雲端容量將成為 AI 數據建設的下一個瓶頸。
paras_en: As the stock market returns to historical highs, Wall Street strategists have observed that large tech companies' massive investments in artificial intelligence (AI) are starting to yield returns, particularly among "hyperscalers" with significant cloud businesses.
Truist Chief Investment Strategist Keith Lerner notes that "spending is leading to profits," indicating that the payback potential of AI investments is gradually emerging.
Based on strong earnings outlooks and cloud demand, JPMorgan has raised its target price for the S&P 500 index to 8,000 from 7,800.

Among the major tech giants, cloud businesses have shone particularly brightly. Microsoft's (MSFT-US) Azure business has surpassed $100 billion in annual sales for the first time, driving its cloud revenue to a historical record and expected to accelerate further this quarter. Amazon's (AMZN-US) AWS growth rate reached 36.7%, the fastest pace in 18 quarters. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) cloud business has also shown explosive growth, while Meta (META-US) is even considering renting out some of its computing capacity.

All these commitments require more investment, according to a Goldman Sachs report, which found that the accumulated backlogged orders of the top four cloud service providers have exceeded $230 billion, up 16% from the first quarter.
To meet the strong demand, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta are expected to collectively invest around $725 billion to $760 billion in capital expenditures to build AI infrastructure this year.

JPMorgan strategist Dubravko Lakos-Bujas notes that while most companies' free cash flow may still be negative in the 2027 fiscal year, their business growth rate has already surpassed spending growth, signaling that demand is catching up with massive capital expenditures. Analysts predict that the monetization process may begin to outpace spending growth, supporting future revenue growth and alleviating concerns about return on investment (ROIC).
Furthermore, Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye believes that cloud capacity will become the next bottleneck in AI data construction, following semiconductors and memory.

items.title: 「木頭姐」Q2大砍輝達、AMD、台積電！砸4.43億美元押SpaceX
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）今年第二季投資組合出現明顯轉向，除了新建倉SpaceX(SPCX-US) 並押注太空產業，也同步加碼人工智慧（AI）與生技領域，另一方面則減持輝達(NVDA-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 及台積電(2330-TW) 等半導體股，顯示其「顛覆性創新」投資策略正從AI硬體進一步轉向太空、醫療及金融科技等領域。
根據相關持倉資料，ARK 2026年第2季持倉總市值達154.56億美元，較第1季的128.59億美元增加20.2%；持倉標的由182檔增加至189檔，前十大持股占比則從40.03%降至約36%。基金第2季業績達29.06%。
其中最受矚目的操作，是ARK新建倉SpaceX。旗下ETF合計買進約329萬股，投入約4.43億美元，使SpaceX一舉成為第2季前十大持股之一，占整體持倉約2.87%。
SpaceX此次進入ARK投資組合，被視為伍德押注太空經濟的重要訊號。相關資料顯示，ARK在SpaceX IPO時進場，並將太空運輸及Starlink衛星網路視為未來成長的重要來源。
伍德長期看好SpaceX，並曾將其形容為可能成為人類歷史上最重要的企業之一。ARK內部模型對SpaceX 2030年的估值則設定不同情境，其中基準情境為2.5兆美元、樂觀情境為3.1兆美元、悲觀情境為1.7兆美元。
SpaceX也並非ARK唯一押注的太空相關標的。第2季ARK同時加碼Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) ，以及Joby Aviation Inc(JOBY-US) 、Archer Aviation(ACHR-US) 等電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）公司，進一步擴大太空與新型交通工具的配置。
儘管投資重心出現變化，特斯拉仍是ARK第2季第一大持股，持股市值約10.5億美元，占整體投資組合6.8%。
不過，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的組合占比已從第1季的8.16%進一步降至6.8%。資料顯示，ARK第2季持有特斯拉約276萬股，持股數量較前季下降約2.5%。
特斯拉自2019年以來已連續27個季度成為ARK第一大持股，但近幾季其在整體投資組合中的比重持續降低。相較之下，SpaceX此次進場，顯示伍德正將部分投資重心延伸至太空領域。

生技成為另一大加碼方向

除了太空，ARK第2季也明顯增加生技相關持股，其中CRISPR治療(CRSP-US) 及Tempus AI(TEM-US) 尤為突出。
CRISPR治療第2季持股增加約7.5%，持倉市值約5.7億美元，占比3.69%，躍居ARK第二大持股。
Tempus AI則是ARK第2季增持幅度最大的主要持股之一，持股數量增加約27%，持倉市值約5.4億美元，占比3.49%。
ARK同時持有Beam Therapeutics Inc(BEAM-US) 等基因編輯公司。從整體操作來看，伍德持續將AI與生物科技結合視為重要投資方向，押注AI在醫療資料、精準醫療及基因技術等領域的應用。

半導體持股全面減碼　輝達減持逾17%

與生技、太空形成鮮明對比的是，ARK第2季對半導體相關持股進行減碼。
超微半導體第2季持股減少約5%，持倉市值約5.2億美元，占比3.36%，由第1季第二大持股位置下滑。
輝達的減持幅度更為明顯，第2季持股減少17.47%。台積電持股則減少16.15%。
此外，ARK第2季也新建倉博通(AVGO-US) ，並買進AI晶片業者Cerebras，顯示其並非全面退出AI硬體，而是在AI晶片領域進行持股調整。
從整體配置來看，伍德正在降低部分成熟半導體公司的持股，同時尋找ASIC、AI軟體及其他新型運算架構的投資機會。

金融科技加碼　Robinhood、Circle受青睞

金融科技與加密貨幣也是ARK第2季的另一個加碼方向。
Robinhood(HOOD-US) 第2季持股增加約24.9%，持倉市值達5億美元，占比3.24%，躍居前十大持股第6名。
Circle(CRCL-US) 則增持約9.1%，持倉市值約4.8億美元，占比3.11%。ARK持有的另一項主要加密相關資產Coinbase(COIN-US) ，則減持約7%。
此外，ARK也增加對Bullish(BLSH-US) 等加密貨幣交易平台的配置，反映伍德仍將區塊鏈、加密金融及相關金融服務視為具顛覆潛力的投資領域。

Meta近乎退出　Google反成AI布局標的

大型科技股方面，Meta(META-US) 成為ARK第2季明顯減碼的標的之一。
Meta在第1季已遭減持48.42%，當時持倉市值約8,800萬美元，占比0.68%，第2季則進一步接近清倉或僅留下極小部位。
相較之下，ARK在第1季大幅增加Google(GOOGL-US) 持股，增持幅度達31.97%，第2季也持續加碼。這顯示伍德在大型科技股中的配置也出現差異化，對AI搜尋等領域的布局相對受到重視。

組合更加分散　但高波動特性仍在

從整體持倉來看，ARK第2季共有189檔標的，前十大持股約占36%，前三大持股則約占13.85%，整體組合相較第1季更加分散。
目前前十大持股依序包括特斯拉、CRISPR治療、超微半導體、Tempus AI、Shopify(SHOP-US) 、Robinhood、Palantir(PLTR-US) 、Circle、SpaceX及Coinbase。
從產業配置來看，AI、生技與基因技術、金融科技與區塊鏈、太空探索、機器人及能源儲存等仍是ARK布局的主要創新主題。
伍德此次調整的核心特徵，在於降低部分AI硬體及成熟晶片標的的配置，同時將資金轉向SpaceX、生技、金融科技與新型交通等領域。這也延續ARK長期尋找下一個高成長創新平台的投資策略。
不過，這類高成長標的本身也伴隨較高波動與不確定性。SpaceX、生技公司及加密金融相關企業均仍處於快速發展階段，因此ARK第2季近30%的單季報酬，也與其集中布局高成長創新題材的投資風格密切相關。

items.title: AI盛宴正如火如荼進行 華爾街卻盯著30年美債冷汗直流
items.title_en: AI Frenzy Continues to Fuel Market Rally, But Wall Street Worries About 30-Year Treasury Yields
paras: 投資人對大型科技股與AI資本開支的樂觀情緒，近日再次將美股推上歷史新高。在經濟展現韌性、需求不墜的背景下，這波漲勢幾乎只有一個真正對手：利率上行。
科技股歷來對美債殖利率敏感，因其高市值建立在「未來成長折現」之上，AI相關資本支出往往需時數年才能回本，而利率決定華爾街如何把未來利潤折回當下價值。當通膨推升利率，遠期收益現值就被壓低，估值倍數高的股票首當其衝遭拋售。
Domini Impact Investments金融研究主管 Maria Llerena說：「評價倍數高的股票，通常在利率上升時被出脫。」
上週，美國核心CPI與PPI溫和，削弱聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注，標普500再寫新高，那斯達克100距6月來收盤高點僅差約 2%，但美國通膨率仍明顯高於2%目標，交易員仍賭年底Fed至少再升息一次。
更關鍵的是長端殖利率，30年期美債殖利率徘徊2007年以來高位，上週四(13日)30年期美債拍賣得標殖利率更創下2001年來最高。
對AI基建巨頭來說，利率走高是實質風險。Alphabet有270億美元債券在2056年後到期，亞馬遜約320億、Meta約210億；四家加上微軟，2026 年合計資本開支預估7400 億美元，2027年再攀至1兆美元。
過去資本支出多靠現金流自籌，如今逐漸舉債，Llerena警告：「利率及其對估值的影響，會有更多疑問。」
AI支出週期能跑多遠，不只看需求，也看30年美債殖利率肯不肯退。若長端利率居高不下，即便是Alphabet、微軟等現金牛，也得面對「未來利潤折現被砍」的估值逆風。
paras_en: Investors' optimism about large-cap tech stocks and AI capital expenditures has pushed the US stock market to new highs recently. Against the backdrop of economic resilience and unrelenting demand, this rally has almost only one true opponent: rising interest rates.

Tech stocks have historically been sensitive to US Treasury yields, as their high valuations are built on 'discounted future growth.' AI-related capital expenditures often take years to break even, and interest rates determine how Wall Street values future profits in the present. As inflation pushes up interest rates, the present value of future returns is compressed, and stocks with high valuation multiples are the first to be sold off.
Domini Impact Investments' research director Maria Llerena said, 'Stocks with high valuation multiples are usually the ones that get dumped when interest rates rise.'

Last week, the US core CPI and PPI were mild, weakening the Fed's 9 September rate hike bet, and the S&P 500 wrote new highs. The Nasdaq 100 was just 2% away from its June closing high, but the US inflation rate remains significantly above the 2% target, and traders still bet on at least one more rate hike by the end of the year.

More importantly, long-term Treasury yields are a concern. The 30-year Treasury yield has been hovering at a high since 2007, and last Thursday (13th), the 30-year Treasury auction yield reached a new high since 2001.

For AI infrastructure giants, rising interest rates are a real risk. Alphabet has $27 billion in debt maturing after 2056, Amazon has around $32 billion, and Meta has around $21 billion. The four companies, plus Microsoft, are expected to spend a combined $740 trillion in 2026 and $1 trillion in 2027.

In the past, capital expenditures were largely self-funded through cash flow, but now they are increasingly relying on debt. Llerena warned, 'The impact of interest rates on valuation will raise more questions.'

The duration of AI spending cycles is not just about demand, but also about whether 30-year Treasury yields will come down. If long-term interest rates remain high, even cash-rich companies like Alphabet and Microsoft will face the headwind of 'discounted future profits being cut.'

items.title: 輝達5000億AI融資計劃藏隱憂？川普顧問示警「暗GPU」：AI算力過剩恐引爆投資危機
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正試圖與大型投資機構合作，將GPU從單純的硬體設備轉化為可融資、可產生收益的資產，以協助人工智慧（AI）基礎設施業者解決龐大的資本支出需求。不過，這項計畫也面臨來自川普政府圈內的風險警告。
美國總統川普科學與技術顧問委員會成員David Sacks近日在《All In Podcast》節目中指出，AI算力市場目前真正值得擔心的並不是需求不足，而是供給擴張過快。
他指出，一旦市場出現大量閒置GPU，也就是所謂的「暗GPU」（dark GPU），可能對整個AI基礎設施投資鏈造成重大衝擊。
Sacks以網路泡沫時期的「暗光纖」（dark fiber）作為類比。2000年代初，電信業者曾大舉鋪設光纖，但實際需求遠低於預期，導致大量光纖閒置，價格隨後崩跌。
Sacks認為，若AI資料中心建設速度超過實際算力需求，GPU市場可能重演類似情況。
他表示：「對我來說，最大的風險不在需求側，最大的風險是算力出現過剩、出現過度建設。」
Sacks警告，如果最終形成「暗GPU」，將對所有相關業者造成嚴重衝擊，尤其是那些在建設算力基礎設施時，以每瓦30至50美元現貨價格作為預期的業者。
這項價格估算與馬斯克此前對AI算力價值的說法有關。據報導，馬斯克曾在SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部電話會議中表示，AI算力價值約為每瓦30至50美元，並據此估算，如果能提供1GW算力，到2027年底可能帶來3,000億至5,000億美元營收。
然而，算力基礎設施業者Nebius隨後披露，其多年期雲端服務協議的年合約價值約為每MW 2,000萬至2,500萬美元。
換句話說，馬斯克所估算的價格可能反映短期協議中的溢價水準，而非整個產業的普遍定價。

資料中心建設阻力反而降低供給過剩風險

值得注意的是，Sacks雖然警告AI算力過剩可能造成市場崩潰，但他認為，目前資料中心擴建面臨的政治阻力，反而可能成為防止供給過剩的一道「保險」。
Sacks指出，如果大量業者同時搶進算力供應，最終造成供給過剩，市場就可能面臨崩潰。但目前資料中心建設本身就相當困難，加上各種政治阻力，使算力供給難以快速擴張。
他表示，正是這些阻力，可能讓AI算力供給相對於快速成長的需求維持在較低水準。換言之，資料中心建設的門檻越高，供給就越難在短時間內大幅增加，反而有助於降低「暗GPU」出現的可能性。

AI資本支出龐大　輝達尋求打通融資管道

Sacks同時說明輝達推動GPU金融化的原因。他認為，AI基礎設施業者目前面臨的資本支出規模，已經超出單靠股權與傳統債務融資可以輕易負擔的程度。
Sacks以馬斯克的擴張計畫為例指出，馬斯克預計明年新增約6至8GW算力，相關資本支出可能達3,000億至4,000億美元，而其公司近期透過股權與債務融資籌得約1,000億美元，仍存在龐大的資金缺口。
在這種情況下，Sacks認為，向GPU供應商取得「賣方融資」可能成為其中一種解決方案。
他指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳目前正建立一套信用額度，並透過大型銀行與私募股權機構，向下游買家提供融資管道。
這項計畫的核心概念，是讓GPU不再只是需要大量前期資本支出的硬體，而是轉變為具有金融屬性的資產。透過輝達提供殘值支持，GPU可以被納入融資架構，讓持有者得以利用其未來產生收益的能力取得資金。

items.title: 初期掉電快、後期很耐用！特斯拉Model Y一年跑4萬公里後 電池容量還有91%
items.title_en: Tesla Model Y's Battery Degradation: Initial Drop-Off, Then Long-Term Reliability
paras: 電動車車主最擔心電池「越用越短」，但最新實測數據顯示，電動車電池的衰減其實集中在初期，隨後便會趨於平緩。
根據《Insideevs》報導，美國網紅Andy Slye駕駛2026年式特斯拉Model Y Premium後驅版一年、行駛約4萬公里後，透過第三方服務Recurrent估算，電池健康度仍維持在91%左右，讓他直言「完全不擔心」。
這一發現與電池分析機構Voltest的研究吻合。Voltest指出，採用鎳基電池的長續航特斯拉車款，最明顯的容量衰減多發生前兩到三年或行駛8萬公里內，一旦度過初期階段，約90%的健康度便會成為穩定基準，後續衰減曲線將大幅趨緩。
Recurrent透過分析車輛回傳的電量狀態、預估續航、行駛里程、充電紀錄與溫度等數據，交叉比對同型車款得出結論。Slye平時主要在家中以交流電充電，僅偶爾使用Supercharger超級充電站，且車輛第一年都在氣候溫和的肯塔基州度過，並未長期暴露於會加速電池老化的高溫環境，這代表91%的數據並非來自頻繁快充或酷熱氣候的極端損耗。
Slye曾進行滿電至0%的完整續航測試，以高速公路車速實測跑出483公里，恰好符合預估值。他計算，若日常只充至80%，實際續航約386公里，對通勤與生活已綽綽有餘。他笑稱，自己本來就不喜歡一次開這麼遠。
實際案例也印證上述趨勢：一輛行駛三年的高里程Model 3計程車，電池容量仍保有88.5%，甚至一輛2015年式Model S P85D，在累積近25.7萬公里後，健康度還有約86%。
專家指出，早期衰減不代表未來10萬英里(約16萬公里)表現，電池壽命仍受駕駛習慣、氣候與充電頻率等多重因素影響，但對大多數車主而言，「初期掉電快、後期很耐用」的規律，無疑是一顆定心丸。
paras_en: Electric vehicle owners are often concerned that their car's battery will degrade over time, but recent data suggests that the initial drop-off in battery capacity is concentrated in the early stages, with a subsequent leveling off.

According to a report by Insideevs, American social media influencer Andy Slye drove his 2026 Tesla Model Y Premium rear-wheel drive for a year, covering approximately 40,000 kilometers, and using a third-party service called Recurrent, estimated that the battery health was still around 91%.

This finding is consistent with research by Voltest, a battery analysis company. Voltest notes that Tesla models with nickel-based batteries, which have a long range, experience the most significant capacity degradation within the first two to three years or within the first 80,000 kilometers. Once this initial period is passed, around 90% of the battery health becomes a stable baseline, with subsequent degradation curves becoming much flatter.

Recurrent analyzed the vehicle's returned energy state, estimated range, mileage, charging records, and temperature data to cross-reference with other models of the same type and draw conclusions. Slye typically charges his car at home using alternating current and only occasionally uses Supercharger fast-charging stations, and his car spent its first year in the mild climate of Kentucky, without prolonged exposure to high temperatures that can accelerate battery degradation.

Slye has performed a full-range test from 100% to 0% and achieved a range of 483 kilometers at highway speeds, exactly matching the estimated value. He calculated that if he only charged to 80%, the actual range would be around 386 kilometers, which is more than sufficient for daily commutes and living. He jokingly said that he didn't like driving that far anyway.

Real-world examples also confirm this trend: a three-year-old high-mileage Model 3 taxi car still has a battery capacity of 88.5%, and a 2015 Model S P85D with nearly 257,000 kilometers on the clock still has a battery health of around 86%.

Experts note that early degradation does not necessarily mean poor performance over the next 100,000 miles (approximately 160,000 kilometers), as battery lifespan is influenced by multiple factors, including driving habits, climate, and charging frequency. However, for most owners, the rule of thumb that 'initial drop-off is fast, but long-term reliability is good' is undoubtedly a reassuring one.

items.title: 「光進銅退」時代來了！輝達CPO交換器正式出貨：功耗暴降80%、頻寬衝上409.6Tb/s
items.title_en: The Era of 'Optical Over Copper' Has Arrived! HUAWEI's CPO Interchangeable Module Officially Delivered: Power Consumption Drops 80%, Bandwidth Reaches 409.6Tb/s
paras: 輝達上週五(14日)透過官方社群帳號宣布，全球首款進入量產的200G/lane CPO乙太網路交換器系統「Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics」正式出貨，CoreWeave、Lambda 與甲骨文為首批採用客戶，該產品在今年5-7月進入生產階段，標誌著資料中心網路架構正式邁入「光進銅退」的新紀元。
Spectrum-X基於新一代 Spectrum-6交換晶片打造，採用共封裝光學(CPO)技術，將光學引擎與交換ASIC直接整合於同一模組內，電訊號傳輸路徑從傳統的 15 至 30 公分 PCB 走線縮短至毫米級。
相較於傳統可插拔收發器架構，光損耗從約22dB大幅降至4dB，訊號完整性提升64倍。單顆Spectrum-6晶片交換容量達 102.4Tb/s，為上一代兩倍；旗艦機型SN6800可配置為512個 800Gb/s或2048個200Gb/s埠，總頻寬高達409.6Tb/s，同時雷射數量減少75%、功耗降低80%，平均故障間隔時間提升十倍。
這項技術突破背後，是輝達與全球供應鏈的深度協同：台積電提供先進矽光子製程，矽品負責晶圓級與晶片級封測，Lumentum供應雷射晶片，天孚通信完成模組子組件組裝，鴻海則擔綱整機交換器系統組裝，輝達並在自有設施執行出貨前最終測試，確保產品良率與可靠性。
值得關注的是，輝達近月在CPO領域的投資動作頻頻。今年3月分別向Lumentum與Coherent各投資20億美元，並簽署多年供應協議，5月再跟康寧達成策略合作，透過最高 27 億美元投資在美新建三座先進工廠，短短三個月累計投資至少65億美元，顯示輝達將光互連技術視為下一代AI工廠的核心戰略。
隨著AI算力叢集從萬卡擴張至十萬卡、百萬卡規模，資料中心瓶頸已從單顆GPU算力轉向叢集互聯能力。市場研究機構數據顯示，今年全球CPO市場規模預計達20億美元，年增逾400%，高盛更預測2028年將衝上910億美元。
隨著輝達Vera Rubin平台量產持續推進，矽光互連可望成為標準配備，相關供應鏈景氣度持續看升。
paras_en: HUAWEI announced on Friday last week (14th) through its official social media account that the world's first 200G/lane CPO Ethernet network exchange system, 'Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics', has officially been delivered. CoreWeave, Lambda, and Oracle are the first batch of customers to adopt this product, which entered the production stage in May-July this year, marking the beginning of the era of 'optical over copper' in data center network architecture.

Spectrum-X is based on the new-generation Spectrum-6 exchange chip, using the CPO technology to integrate the optical engine and exchange ASIC directly into the same module. The transmission path of the electrical signal is shortened from the traditional 15-30 cm PCB line to millimeter-level.

Compared to traditional plug-and-play transceiver architectures, the optical loss has been significantly reduced from approximately 22 dB to 4 dB, with signal integrity improved by 64 times. A single Spectrum-6 chip can exchange 102.4Tb/s, which is twice that of the previous generation. The flagship model SN6800 can be configured with 512 800Gb/s or 2048 200Gb/s ports, with a total bandwidth of up to 409.6Tb/s, while reducing laser numbers by 75% and power consumption by 80%, and increasing average time between failures by ten times.

Behind this technology breakthrough is the deep collaboration between HUAWEI and the global supply chain: TSMC provides advanced silicon photonics processes, SilTerra is responsible for wafer-level and chip-level packaging, Lumentum supplies laser chips, and Foxconn completes module component assembly, while HUAWEI assembles the entire exchange system and performs final testing at its own facilities to ensure product yield and reliability.

Notably, HUAWEI has been actively investing in the CPO field in recent months. In March, it invested $2 billion each in Lumentum and Coherent, signing multi-year supply agreements, and in May, it reached a strategic cooperation with Corning, investing up to $2.7 billion to build three advanced factories in the US. In just three months, HUAWEI has invested at least $6.5 billion, demonstrating its vision of optical interconnect technology as a core strategy for the next-generation AI factory.

As AI computing clusters expand from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of cards, data center bottlenecks have shifted from individual GPU performance to cluster interconnect capabilities. Market research data shows that the global CPO market is expected to reach $2 billion this year, with a year-over-year growth of over 400%, and Goldman Sachs predicts that it will reach $9.1 billion in 2028.
With the continuous progress of HUAWEI's Vera Rubin platform, silicon photonics interconnects are expected to become standard equipment, and the supply chain outlook remains optimistic.

items.title: 高盛助攻輝達打造5000億美元融資平台 破解AI基建最大資金瓶頸
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Helps Hicloud Build $50 Billion Financing Platform to Break AI Infrastructure Funding Bottleneck
paras: AI軍備競賽正面臨一個買得起晶片，卻未必扛得住資產負債表的殘酷現實，AI晶片巨頭輝達正試圖解決這個日益尖銳的融資瓶頸。
輝達上周一(10日)宣布與高盛、阿波羅、貝萊德、黑石、布魯克菲爾德及 KKR等金融巨頭聯手，籌建規模超過5000億美元的獨立融資平台，專門服務輝達驅動的AI基礎設施建設。
根據規劃，輝達可能為相關交易提供最高1250億美元(約佔總規模 25%)支持。高盛正與保險公司、銀行及資產管理機構接洽具體架構，其資產管理部門可提供初級資本與私人信貸，投資銀行部門則負責將債務配置給私人信貸基金，最終推向公開債券市場。這意味著客戶不用將龐大採購成本全數壓在自身資產負債表上，即可持續取得日益昂貴的輝達系統。
這項計畫的核心戰略意義在於，輝達試圖將GPU及全端AI系統轉化為「可投資的基礎設施資產類別」，融資與資產本身及使用綁定的收入掛鉤，而非過度依賴傳統供應商融資模式，這有望大幅擴大有能力部署超大規模AI聚落的客戶群體。
財報數據為此提供了強力背書，輝達2027財年第一季營收年增85%至816億美元，其中資料中心業務暴漲92%至752億美元。
對投資人而言，5000 億美元計畫若順利落地，可望透過消除資本獲取瓶頸進一步擴大可觸達市場。
但風險同樣不容忽視，輝達可能背負高達1250億美元的潛在支持責任，市場需密切關注融資項目品質、客戶信用狀況及實際保留風險部位。
輝達將在8月26日公布第二財季財報，屆時市場將聚焦資料中心增長、遠期需求指引及對融資架構的相關表態。若機構投資人真正將輝達硬體視為可融資基礎設施，AI支出週期可望顯著延長；反之，則可能引發「融資是否在人為支撐需求」的質疑。
paras_en: The AI arms race is facing a harsh reality: being able to afford chips does not necessarily mean being able to bear the weight of the balance sheet. Hicloud, a leading AI chip company, is trying to solve this increasingly acute funding bottleneck.

Hicloud announced on Monday (10th) that it has partnered with Goldman Sachs, Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, and KKR to build an independent financing platform with a scale of over $50 billion, dedicated to serving Hicloud's AI infrastructure construction.

According to the plan, Hicloud may provide up to $125 billion (approximately 25% of the total scale) in support for related transactions. Goldman Sachs is in talks with insurance companies, banks, and asset management institutions to finalize the structure, with its asset management department providing primary capital and private loans, and its investment banking department responsible for allocating debt to private loan funds and ultimately pushing it to the public bond market.

This plan's core strategic significance lies in Hicloud's attempt to transform GPU and full-stack AI systems into 'investable infrastructure asset categories', with financing tied to the assets themselves and the associated income, rather than relying too heavily on traditional supplier financing models. This could significantly expand the customer base capable of deploying large-scale AI clusters.
Financial data provides strong backing for this effort. Hicloud's first-quarter revenue for fiscal year 2027 increased by 85% to $8.16 billion, with data center business surging 92% to $7.52 billion.
For investors, the $50 billion plan, if successful, could further expand the addressable market by eliminating capital access bottlenecks.

However, risks cannot be ignored. Hicloud may bear a potential support responsibility of up to $125 billion, and the market needs to closely monitor the quality of the financing projects, customer creditworthiness, and actual risk retention positions.

Hicloud will release its second-quarter earnings on August 26, with the market focusing on data center growth, long-term demand guidance, and related statements on the financing framework. If institutional investors truly view Hicloud hardware as a financiable infrastructure, the AI spending cycle may be significantly extended; otherwise, it may raise questions about whether funding is artificially supporting demand.

items.title: Anthropic揭Claude Code「省錢6招」！善用快取、/clear降低Token成本
paras: Anthropic近日發布一篇部落格文章，針對開發者使用Claude Code時容易出現的Token浪費問題，整理出6項降低成本的實用技巧。
官方指出，Claude Code的使用成本不只取決於選用哪個模型，也與推理強度、上下文長度及提示快取是否命中密切相關；若缺乏上下文管理，同一項程式開發任務的成本可能出現數倍差距。
Anthropic建議，開發者完成一項任務後應立即使用「/clear」清除對話，避免前一項工作的檔案內容、指令輸出與探索過程持續留在上下文中，並在開始工作時就確定模型與推理強度，減少後續切換造成的快取失效。

Anthropic列6招降低Claude Code成本


在不同任務之間執行「/clear」，避免把之前無關的上下文繼續送到模型，進而減少Token消耗。
開始工作前，先確定好模型和推理強度，因為中途更改其中任何一個，都可能導致提示詞快取失效，進而增加Token成本。
不要只寫出檔名，而是直接用「@」提及文件，使檔案會直接附加到訊息中，省去一次Read調用，並避免Claude再去搜尋檔案。
對輸出冗長的指令加上靜默參數，或把指令交給子代理執行。因為命令輸出會像檔案一樣加入對話，並且在整個會話期間都會保留。
在新會話開始時執行一次「/context」。它會顯示目前載入的內容（例如 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 工具定義），方便用戶刪除不必要的內容。
暫時離開鍵盤前執行「/compact」。提示詞快取通常一小時後就會過期，而在快取仍然有效時進行對話壓縮，成本要低得多。


Claude Code成本關鍵在Token如何被計算

Anthropic也進一步說明Claude Code背後的Token消耗機制。每次使用者發出指令時，模型首先需要進行「預填充」，讀取系統提示詞、CLAUDE.md、使用者訊息及過往對話等輸入內容；接著進入「解碼」（decode）階段，產生模型回覆、思考內容及工具呼叫等輸出。
兩者的運算方式並不相同。預填充會一次處理輸入內容，而解碼則是逐個Token產生輸出，因此輸出Token的成本高於輸入Token。
模型本身則決定每個Token的價格，而推理強度會影響Token使用量。
Anthropic指出，推理強度越高，模型需要產生的思考Token越多，因此開發者不應在所有任務上都使用最高推理強度，而應根據工作的複雜程度選擇合適的模型與設定。

提示快取成為降低成本的重要工具

在Claude Code的成本結構中，提示快取是另一個關鍵因素。
Claude Code的請求通常會包含相同的前綴，例如系統提示詞、工具定義、CLAUDE.md以及既有對話歷史。如果下一次請求的前綴內容與前一次完全一致，系統可以直接使用先前的計算結果，而不必重新處理全部內容。
Anthropic指出，快取讀取只要正常輸入價的0.1倍，可以直接省掉90%。雖然首次寫入快取需要較高成本，但之後的請求可以持續利用既有快取。
不過，快取並非永久有效，而且必須維持連續匹配。Anthropic列出幾種可能導致快取失效的情況，包括切換模型、改變推理強度、開啟或關閉Fast mode、使用「/compact」重新整理對話、快取逾期，以及長時間後恢復舊會話。
其中，模型與推理強度的切換尤其值得注意。Anthropic指出，不同模型各自擁有獨立快取，因此從一個模型切換到另一個模型後，原本的對話歷史可能需要重新進行預填充；推理強度同樣屬於快取條件之一。
此外，Anthropic也提醒使用者注意「opusplan」模式。由於該模式會在不同階段切換模型，因此進入或離開相關模式都可能造成快取失效，頻繁切換可能增加額外成本。

對話越長，累積成本也越高

即使成功利用快取降低重複處理成本，Anthropic仍提醒，對話本身持續膨脹仍會增加Token使用量。
Claude每讀取一個檔案、執行一次指令，都可能將相關內容加入對話歷史。隨著工作輪數增加，後續請求需要攜帶的上下文也會越來越長。
Claude Code設有機制處理過大的命令輸出：當輸出超過一定長度時，內容會被寫入暫存檔案，而對話中只保留摘要。不過，較短但仍然龐大的輸出仍可能直接留在上下文中。
例如測試工具產生大量測試結果，即使沒有超過系統設定的門檻，這些內容仍可能持續佔據後續對話空間。
因此，Anthropic再次強調，讓命令保持精簡、將大型工作交給子代理，以及適時清除或壓縮對話，都是降低上下文膨脹的重要方式。
除了「/clear」與「/compact」之外，Anthropic也提到「/rewind」。如果最近幾輪對話出現偏離，可以利用「/rewind」移除後續內容，同時保留較早的對話與快取狀態。

AI程式開發開始出現「Token管理」能力

從Anthropic整理的這些技巧可以看出，Claude Code的使用效率已不只是模型能力或程式設計技巧的問題，如何管理上下文、控制輸出、維持快取及選擇適當推理強度，也逐漸成為影響開發成本的重要因素。
對開發者而言，真正需要避免的並非單次使用大量Token，而是在長時間、多輪次的工作流程中，讓無關的上下文不斷累積，並因模型或設定切換導致原本可以重複利用的快取失效。
Anthropic此次公布的6項建議，核心邏輯也相當明確：讓每一次請求只攜帶真正需要的內容、讓能夠快取的內容持續命中，並將不必要的大量輸出隔離在主對話之外。對於高頻率使用Claude Code的開發者而言，這些操作將直接影響相同工作量下的Token消耗。

items.title: 支出正在轉化為收益？華爾街科技巨頭AI投資變現
items.title_en: Is Spending Turning into Profit? Wall Street Tech Giants' AI Investment Begins to Bear Fruit
paras: 隨著股市重回歷史新高，華爾街策略師觀察到大型科技公司在人工智慧(AI)領域的巨額投資正開始產生回報，特別是擁有龐大雲端業務的「超大規模業者」(hyperscalers)。
Truist 首席投資策略師 Keith Lerner 指出，「支出正在引領獲利」，這顯示出 AI 投資的變現能力正逐步顯現。
基於強勁的盈餘展望與雲端需求，摩根大通已將標普 500 指數的目標價從 7,800 點調升至 8,000 點。

在各大科技巨頭中，雲端業務的表現尤為亮眼。微軟(MSFT-US)的 Azure 業務年銷售額首次突破 1,000 億美元，帶動其雲端營收創下歷史紀錄，並預計本季將進一步加速成長。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下的 AWS 成長率達到 36.7%，創下 18 季以來的最快增速。Alphabet (GOOGL-US)的雲端業務同樣呈現爆發式成長，而 Meta (META-US)甚至在考慮出租其部分的計算能力。
所有這些承諾都需要更多投資，根據美銀研究報告，前四大雲端服務商的積壓訂單金額已超過 2.3 兆美元，較第一季增長 16%。
為應對強勁需求，Alphabet、亞馬遜、微軟和 Meta 今年預計將集體投入約 7,250 億至 7,600 億美元的資本支出用於建構 AI 基礎設施。
摩根大通策略師 Dubravko Lakos-Bujas 指出，雖然多數業者的自由現金流在 2027 財年可能仍為負值，但其業務增長速度已超過支出增長，這是一個需求開始追上龐大資本支出的信號。分析師預測，貨幣化進程可能開始比支出增長更快，這將支撐未來的營收成長並緩解投資者對投資報酬率(ROIC)的疑慮。
此外，Sevens Report Research 創辦人 Tom Essaye 認為，在半導體和記憶體之後，雲端容量將成為 AI 數據建設的下一個瓶頸。
paras_en: As the stock market returns to historical highs, Wall Street strategists have observed that large tech companies' massive investments in artificial intelligence (AI) are starting to yield returns, particularly among "hyperscalers" with significant cloud businesses.
Truist Chief Investment Strategist Keith Lerner notes that "spending is leading to profits," indicating that the payback potential of AI investments is gradually emerging.
Based on strong earnings outlooks and cloud demand, JPMorgan has raised its target price for the S&P 500 index to 8,000 from 7,800.

Among the major tech giants, cloud businesses have shone particularly brightly. Microsoft's (MSFT-US) Azure business has surpassed $100 billion in annual sales for the first time, driving its cloud revenue to a historical record and expected to accelerate further this quarter. Amazon's (AMZN-US) AWS growth rate reached 36.7%, the fastest pace in 18 quarters. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) cloud business has also shown explosive growth, while Meta (META-US) is even considering renting out some of its computing capacity.

All these commitments require more investment, according to a Goldman Sachs report, which found that the accumulated backlogged orders of the top four cloud service providers have exceeded $230 billion, up 16% from the first quarter.
To meet the strong demand, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta are expected to collectively invest around $725 billion to $760 billion in capital expenditures to build AI infrastructure this year.

JPMorgan strategist Dubravko Lakos-Bujas notes that while most companies' free cash flow may still be negative in the 2027 fiscal year, their business growth rate has already surpassed spending growth, signaling that demand is catching up with massive capital expenditures. Analysts predict that the monetization process may begin to outpace spending growth, supporting future revenue growth and alleviating concerns about return on investment (ROIC).
Furthermore, Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye believes that cloud capacity will become the next bottleneck in AI data construction, following semiconductors and memory.

items.title: 伊朗懸賞3萬美元「殺美軍」！女性出手獎金翻倍
paras: 伊朗軍方週日（16日）宣布，將提供最高3萬美元（約新台幣96萬）的獎金，鼓勵民眾殺死或俘虜美國軍人；若由女性完成相關行動，獎金將提高至兩倍。伊朗陸軍司令哈塔米（Amir Hatami）表示，這項計畫是在收到「大量請求」後制定。
根據《南華早報》引述伊朗國營通訊社《IRNA》報導，哈塔米表示：「任何殺死或俘虜並將入侵的美國軍事人員交給伊朗方面的人，都將獲得伊朗伊斯蘭共和國陸軍提供的相當於3萬美元或50億伊朗土曼（Iranian toman）的獎勵。」
土曼是伊朗民間使用的貨幣單位，1土曼相當於1萬伊朗里亞爾。
他還表示：「勇敢的伊朗女性若完成這類行動，將獲得雙倍獎勵。」
哈塔米同時重申伊朗要求美國撤出中東的立場，並表示美軍「不再獲准進入波斯灣、阿曼灣或荷姆茲海峽」。
目前已知在這場中東戰爭期間，美軍並未在伊朗境內部署地面部隊，唯一例外是4月為救援一名墜落的美軍飛行員而執行的行動。
戰事爆發一個多月後，美軍展開大規模救援行動，試圖救出一架F-15戰機的武器系統官。當時約有200名美軍人員及超過170架軍機投入行動，爭取在伊朗部隊找到這名軍人之前將其救出。
救援行動期間，伊朗部隊擊傷一架A-10攻擊機，該機最終在友軍控制區域棄置。
據報導，美軍也放棄並摧毀了部分參與這次任務的軍機，其中包括一架C-130運輸機。
經過近40天的戰鬥後，戰事於4月透過停火暫時告一段落，雙方隨後在6月建立和平談判框架，但該框架最終宣告破裂。
此後，伊朗與美國仍不時發生交火，戰鬥主要集中在伊朗南部以及荷姆茲海峽周邊。
雙方透過中間人維持間接接觸，但目前幾乎看不到外交取得突破的跡象。伊朗也提出重新開放荷姆茲海峽的條件，包括要求賠償戰爭造成的損失。
自戰爭爆發以來，共有17名美軍人員死亡，最近一批死亡事件發生於7月。這些人員全部是在伊朗境外喪生，包括約旦與伊拉克等國家。

items.title: 「木頭姐」Q2大砍輝達、AMD、台積電！砸4.43億美元押SpaceX
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）今年第二季投資組合出現明顯轉向，除了新建倉SpaceX(SPCX-US) 並押注太空產業，也同步加碼人工智慧（AI）與生技領域，另一方面則減持輝達(NVDA-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 及台積電(2330-TW) 等半導體股，顯示其「顛覆性創新」投資策略正從AI硬體進一步轉向太空、醫療及金融科技等領域。
根據相關持倉資料，ARK 2026年第2季持倉總市值達154.56億美元，較第1季的128.59億美元增加20.2%；持倉標的由182檔增加至189檔，前十大持股占比則從40.03%降至約36%。基金第2季業績達29.06%。
其中最受矚目的操作，是ARK新建倉SpaceX。旗下ETF合計買進約329萬股，投入約4.43億美元，使SpaceX一舉成為第2季前十大持股之一，占整體持倉約2.87%。
SpaceX此次進入ARK投資組合，被視為伍德押注太空經濟的重要訊號。相關資料顯示，ARK在SpaceX IPO時進場，並將太空運輸及Starlink衛星網路視為未來成長的重要來源。
伍德長期看好SpaceX，並曾將其形容為可能成為人類歷史上最重要的企業之一。ARK內部模型對SpaceX 2030年的估值則設定不同情境，其中基準情境為2.5兆美元、樂觀情境為3.1兆美元、悲觀情境為1.7兆美元。
SpaceX也並非ARK唯一押注的太空相關標的。第2季ARK同時加碼Rocket Lab (RKLB-US) ，以及Joby Aviation Inc(JOBY-US) 、Archer Aviation(ACHR-US) 等電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）公司，進一步擴大太空與新型交通工具的配置。
儘管投資重心出現變化，特斯拉仍是ARK第2季第一大持股，持股市值約10.5億美元，占整體投資組合6.8%。
不過，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 的組合占比已從第1季的8.16%進一步降至6.8%。資料顯示，ARK第2季持有特斯拉約276萬股，持股數量較前季下降約2.5%。
特斯拉自2019年以來已連續27個季度成為ARK第一大持股，但近幾季其在整體投資組合中的比重持續降低。相較之下，SpaceX此次進場，顯示伍德正將部分投資重心延伸至太空領域。

生技成為另一大加碼方向

除了太空，ARK第2季也明顯增加生技相關持股，其中CRISPR治療(CRSP-US) 及Tempus AI(TEM-US) 尤為突出。
CRISPR治療第2季持股增加約7.5%，持倉市值約5.7億美元，占比3.69%，躍居ARK第二大持股。
Tempus AI則是ARK第2季增持幅度最大的主要持股之一，持股數量增加約27%，持倉市值約5.4億美元，占比3.49%。
ARK同時持有Beam Therapeutics Inc(BEAM-US) 等基因編輯公司。從整體操作來看，伍德持續將AI與生物科技結合視為重要投資方向，押注AI在醫療資料、精準醫療及基因技術等領域的應用。

半導體持股全面減碼　輝達減持逾17%

與生技、太空形成鮮明對比的是，ARK第2季對半導體相關持股進行減碼。
超微半導體第2季持股減少約5%，持倉市值約5.2億美元，占比3.36%，由第1季第二大持股位置下滑。
輝達的減持幅度更為明顯，第2季持股減少17.47%。台積電持股則減少16.15%。
此外，ARK第2季也新建倉博通(AVGO-US) ，並買進AI晶片業者Cerebras，顯示其並非全面退出AI硬體，而是在AI晶片領域進行持股調整。
從整體配置來看，伍德正在降低部分成熟半導體公司的持股，同時尋找ASIC、AI軟體及其他新型運算架構的投資機會。

金融科技加碼　Robinhood、Circle受青睞

金融科技與加密貨幣也是ARK第2季的另一個加碼方向。
Robinhood(HOOD-US) 第2季持股增加約24.9%，持倉市值達5億美元，占比3.24%，躍居前十大持股第6名。
Circle(CRCL-US) 則增持約9.1%，持倉市值約4.8億美元，占比3.11%。ARK持有的另一項主要加密相關資產Coinbase(COIN-US) ，則減持約7%。
此外，ARK也增加對Bullish(BLSH-US) 等加密貨幣交易平台的配置，反映伍德仍將區塊鏈、加密金融及相關金融服務視為具顛覆潛力的投資領域。

Meta近乎退出　Google反成AI布局標的

大型科技股方面，Meta(META-US) 成為ARK第2季明顯減碼的標的之一。
Meta在第1季已遭減持48.42%，當時持倉市值約8,800萬美元，占比0.68%，第2季則進一步接近清倉或僅留下極小部位。
相較之下，ARK在第1季大幅增加Google(GOOGL-US) 持股，增持幅度達31.97%，第2季也持續加碼。這顯示伍德在大型科技股中的配置也出現差異化，對AI搜尋等領域的布局相對受到重視。

組合更加分散　但高波動特性仍在

從整體持倉來看，ARK第2季共有189檔標的，前十大持股約占36%，前三大持股則約占13.85%，整體組合相較第1季更加分散。
目前前十大持股依序包括特斯拉、CRISPR治療、超微半導體、Tempus AI、Shopify(SHOP-US) 、Robinhood、Palantir(PLTR-US) 、Circle、SpaceX及Coinbase。
從產業配置來看，AI、生技與基因技術、金融科技與區塊鏈、太空探索、機器人及能源儲存等仍是ARK布局的主要創新主題。
伍德此次調整的核心特徵，在於降低部分AI硬體及成熟晶片標的的配置，同時將資金轉向SpaceX、生技、金融科技與新型交通等領域。這也延續ARK長期尋找下一個高成長創新平台的投資策略。
不過，這類高成長標的本身也伴隨較高波動與不確定性。SpaceX、生技公司及加密金融相關企業均仍處於快速發展階段，因此ARK第2季近30%的單季報酬，也與其集中布局高成長創新題材的投資風格密切相關。

items.title: AI盛宴正如火如荼進行 華爾街卻盯著30年美債冷汗直流
items.title_en: AI Frenzy Continues to Fuel Market Rally, But Wall Street Worries About 30-Year Treasury Yields
paras: 投資人對大型科技股與AI資本開支的樂觀情緒，近日再次將美股推上歷史新高。在經濟展現韌性、需求不墜的背景下，這波漲勢幾乎只有一個真正對手：利率上行。
科技股歷來對美債殖利率敏感，因其高市值建立在「未來成長折現」之上，AI相關資本支出往往需時數年才能回本，而利率決定華爾街如何把未來利潤折回當下價值。當通膨推升利率，遠期收益現值就被壓低，估值倍數高的股票首當其衝遭拋售。
Domini Impact Investments金融研究主管 Maria Llerena說：「評價倍數高的股票，通常在利率上升時被出脫。」
上週，美國核心CPI與PPI溫和，削弱聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注，標普500再寫新高，那斯達克100距6月來收盤高點僅差約 2%，但美國通膨率仍明顯高於2%目標，交易員仍賭年底Fed至少再升息一次。
更關鍵的是長端殖利率，30年期美債殖利率徘徊2007年以來高位，上週四(13日)30年期美債拍賣得標殖利率更創下2001年來最高。
對AI基建巨頭來說，利率走高是實質風險。Alphabet有270億美元債券在2056年後到期，亞馬遜約320億、Meta約210億；四家加上微軟，2026 年合計資本開支預估7400 億美元，2027年再攀至1兆美元。
過去資本支出多靠現金流自籌，如今逐漸舉債，Llerena警告：「利率及其對估值的影響，會有更多疑問。」
AI支出週期能跑多遠，不只看需求，也看30年美債殖利率肯不肯退。若長端利率居高不下，即便是Alphabet、微軟等現金牛，也得面對「未來利潤折現被砍」的估值逆風。
paras_en: Investors' optimism about large-cap tech stocks and AI capital expenditures has pushed the US stock market to new highs recently. Against the backdrop of economic resilience and unrelenting demand, this rally has almost only one true opponent: rising interest rates.

Tech stocks have historically been sensitive to US Treasury yields, as their high valuations are built on 'discounted future growth.' AI-related capital expenditures often take years to break even, and interest rates determine how Wall Street values future profits in the present. As inflation pushes up interest rates, the present value of future returns is compressed, and stocks with high valuation multiples are the first to be sold off.
Domini Impact Investments' research director Maria Llerena said, 'Stocks with high valuation multiples are usually the ones that get dumped when interest rates rise.'

Last week, the US core CPI and PPI were mild, weakening the Fed's 9 September rate hike bet, and the S&P 500 wrote new highs. The Nasdaq 100 was just 2% away from its June closing high, but the US inflation rate remains significantly above the 2% target, and traders still bet on at least one more rate hike by the end of the year.

More importantly, long-term Treasury yields are a concern. The 30-year Treasury yield has been hovering at a high since 2007, and last Thursday (13th), the 30-year Treasury auction yield reached a new high since 2001.

For AI infrastructure giants, rising interest rates are a real risk. Alphabet has $27 billion in debt maturing after 2056, Amazon has around $32 billion, and Meta has around $21 billion. The four companies, plus Microsoft, are expected to spend a combined $740 trillion in 2026 and $1 trillion in 2027.

In the past, capital expenditures were largely self-funded through cash flow, but now they are increasingly relying on debt. Llerena warned, 'The impact of interest rates on valuation will raise more questions.'

The duration of AI spending cycles is not just about demand, but also about whether 30-year Treasury yields will come down. If long-term interest rates remain high, even cash-rich companies like Alphabet and Microsoft will face the headwind of 'discounted future profits being cut.'

items.title: 記憶體頂部提前？三星、SK海力士遭多家券商下調目標價 價差最多達200萬韓元
items.title_en: Memory Top Seen Ahead of Schedule? Samsung, SK Hynix Downgraded by Multiple Brokerages
paras: 南韓記憶體雙雄三星電子與SK海力士近期遭多家本土券商下修目標價，市場對「記憶體晶片週期是否已過頂」判斷出現明顯分歧。
未來證券以「週期頂峰可能早於預期」為由，將三星股價目標價從39萬韓元砍至35萬，未來資產證券亦從55萬降至37萬，信韓投資從59萬降至45萬，三星證券從50萬降至40萬，唯獨KB證券堅持「供給短缺至少再持續3年」，維持60萬韓元目標價不動。
市場對SK海力士的分歧則更劇烈。未來資產7月29日將目標價從420萬韓元大砍至280萬，信韓投資由420萬降至270萬，NH投資從410萬降至340萬，大信從390萬降至320萬，三星證券從350萬降至300萬，但韓國投資證券逆勢從380萬上調至470萬韓元。目前各家對SK海力士目標價最低270萬、最高470萬，落差達200萬韓元。
空方邏輯集中在通用DRAM/NAND價格居高位、手機與PC採購轉保守，加上2027年原廠擴產釋放供給，擔憂景氣提前見頂。
市場多方則押注AI伺服器與HBM長協(LTA)訂單鎖住需求，供給端受良率與產能爬坡限制，短缺格局短期難解。即便目標價下修，多數券商仍保留「買入」評級，顯示下修的是估值乘數，而非否認AI記憶體中長線成長性。
這波調整自7月底SK海力士財報後加速，反映資本市場正從「漲價週期」框架切換到「AI資本開支可持續性」框架，短期目標價亂流不改產業核心變數，HBM出貨節奏與2027年供給實際落地速度，才是決定三星、海力士下一波段估值的關鍵。
paras_en: South Korean memory duopoly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have recently been downgraded by multiple local brokerages, with the market showing a clear divergence in judgment on whether the memory chip cycle has peaked.

Future Securities downgraded Samsung's target price to 3.5 million won from 3.9 million, citing 'peak cycle may come earlier than expected.' Future Asset Securities also downgraded it to 3.7 million from 5.5 million, Shinhan Investment to 4.5 million from 5.9 million, Samsung Securities to 4 million from 5 million, while KB Securities maintained its 6 million won target price, citing 'supply shortage to last at least 3 years'.

The divergence in judgment on SK Hynix is even more pronounced. Future Asset Securities downgraded its target price to 2.8 million won from 4.2 million on July 29, Shinhan Investment to 2.7 million from 4.2 million, NH Investment to 3.4 million from 4.1 million, Daesung to 3.2 million from 3.9 million, Samsung Securities to 3 million from 3.5 million, but Korea Investment Securities upgraded it to 4.7 million from 3.8 million. The current target prices for SK Hynix range from 2.7 million to 4.7 million, with a difference of 2 million won.
The bearish logic centers around high prices for DRAM/NAND, conservative smartphone and PC purchases, and the release of supply in 2027, with concerns about the economy peaking ahead of schedule.

The market, on the other hand, is betting on AI server and HBM long-term orders locking in demand, with supply-side constraints from yield rates and production capacity, making it difficult to resolve the shortage in the short term. Despite the downgrades, most brokerages still maintain a 'buy' rating, indicating that the downgrades are a matter of valuation multiples rather than denying the long-term growth potential of AI memory.

This round of adjustments has accelerated since the end of July, reflecting the capital market's shift from the 'rising price cycle' framework to the 'sustainability of AI capital expenditure' framework. The short-term target price fluctuations do not change the core variables of the industry, and the HBM shipment rhythm and the actual supply landing speed in 2027 are the key to determining the next round of valuation for Samsung and SK Hynix.

items.title: 輝達5000億AI融資計劃藏隱憂？川普顧問示警「暗GPU」：AI算力過剩恐引爆投資危機
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正試圖與大型投資機構合作，將GPU從單純的硬體設備轉化為可融資、可產生收益的資產，以協助人工智慧（AI）基礎設施業者解決龐大的資本支出需求。不過，這項計畫也面臨來自川普政府圈內的風險警告。
美國總統川普科學與技術顧問委員會成員David Sacks近日在《All In Podcast》節目中指出，AI算力市場目前真正值得擔心的並不是需求不足，而是供給擴張過快。
他指出，一旦市場出現大量閒置GPU，也就是所謂的「暗GPU」（dark GPU），可能對整個AI基礎設施投資鏈造成重大衝擊。
Sacks以網路泡沫時期的「暗光纖」（dark fiber）作為類比。2000年代初，電信業者曾大舉鋪設光纖，但實際需求遠低於預期，導致大量光纖閒置，價格隨後崩跌。
Sacks認為，若AI資料中心建設速度超過實際算力需求，GPU市場可能重演類似情況。
他表示：「對我來說，最大的風險不在需求側，最大的風險是算力出現過剩、出現過度建設。」
Sacks警告，如果最終形成「暗GPU」，將對所有相關業者造成嚴重衝擊，尤其是那些在建設算力基礎設施時，以每瓦30至50美元現貨價格作為預期的業者。
這項價格估算與馬斯克此前對AI算力價值的說法有關。據報導，馬斯克曾在SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部電話會議中表示，AI算力價值約為每瓦30至50美元，並據此估算，如果能提供1GW算力，到2027年底可能帶來3,000億至5,000億美元營收。
然而，算力基礎設施業者Nebius隨後披露，其多年期雲端服務協議的年合約價值約為每MW 2,000萬至2,500萬美元。
換句話說，馬斯克所估算的價格可能反映短期協議中的溢價水準，而非整個產業的普遍定價。

資料中心建設阻力反而降低供給過剩風險

值得注意的是，Sacks雖然警告AI算力過剩可能造成市場崩潰，但他認為，目前資料中心擴建面臨的政治阻力，反而可能成為防止供給過剩的一道「保險」。
Sacks指出，如果大量業者同時搶進算力供應，最終造成供給過剩，市場就可能面臨崩潰。但目前資料中心建設本身就相當困難，加上各種政治阻力，使算力供給難以快速擴張。
他表示，正是這些阻力，可能讓AI算力供給相對於快速成長的需求維持在較低水準。換言之，資料中心建設的門檻越高，供給就越難在短時間內大幅增加，反而有助於降低「暗GPU」出現的可能性。

AI資本支出龐大　輝達尋求打通融資管道

Sacks同時說明輝達推動GPU金融化的原因。他認為，AI基礎設施業者目前面臨的資本支出規模，已經超出單靠股權與傳統債務融資可以輕易負擔的程度。
Sacks以馬斯克的擴張計畫為例指出，馬斯克預計明年新增約6至8GW算力，相關資本支出可能達3,000億至4,000億美元，而其公司近期透過股權與債務融資籌得約1,000億美元，仍存在龐大的資金缺口。
在這種情況下，Sacks認為，向GPU供應商取得「賣方融資」可能成為其中一種解決方案。
他指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳目前正建立一套信用額度，並透過大型銀行與私募股權機構，向下游買家提供融資管道。
這項計畫的核心概念，是讓GPU不再只是需要大量前期資本支出的硬體，而是轉變為具有金融屬性的資產。透過輝達提供殘值支持，GPU可以被納入融資架構，讓持有者得以利用其未來產生收益的能力取得資金。

items.title: 初期掉電快、後期很耐用！特斯拉Model Y一年跑4萬公里後 電池容量還有91%
items.title_en: Tesla Model Y's Battery Degradation: Initial Drop-Off, Then Long-Term Reliability
paras: 電動車車主最擔心電池「越用越短」，但最新實測數據顯示，電動車電池的衰減其實集中在初期，隨後便會趨於平緩。
根據《Insideevs》報導，美國網紅Andy Slye駕駛2026年式特斯拉Model Y Premium後驅版一年、行駛約4萬公里後，透過第三方服務Recurrent估算，電池健康度仍維持在91%左右，讓他直言「完全不擔心」。
這一發現與電池分析機構Voltest的研究吻合。Voltest指出，採用鎳基電池的長續航特斯拉車款，最明顯的容量衰減多發生前兩到三年或行駛8萬公里內，一旦度過初期階段，約90%的健康度便會成為穩定基準，後續衰減曲線將大幅趨緩。
Recurrent透過分析車輛回傳的電量狀態、預估續航、行駛里程、充電紀錄與溫度等數據，交叉比對同型車款得出結論。Slye平時主要在家中以交流電充電，僅偶爾使用Supercharger超級充電站，且車輛第一年都在氣候溫和的肯塔基州度過，並未長期暴露於會加速電池老化的高溫環境，這代表91%的數據並非來自頻繁快充或酷熱氣候的極端損耗。
Slye曾進行滿電至0%的完整續航測試，以高速公路車速實測跑出483公里，恰好符合預估值。他計算，若日常只充至80%，實際續航約386公里，對通勤與生活已綽綽有餘。他笑稱，自己本來就不喜歡一次開這麼遠。
實際案例也印證上述趨勢：一輛行駛三年的高里程Model 3計程車，電池容量仍保有88.5%，甚至一輛2015年式Model S P85D，在累積近25.7萬公里後，健康度還有約86%。
專家指出，早期衰減不代表未來10萬英里(約16萬公里)表現，電池壽命仍受駕駛習慣、氣候與充電頻率等多重因素影響，但對大多數車主而言，「初期掉電快、後期很耐用」的規律，無疑是一顆定心丸。
paras_en: Electric vehicle owners are often concerned that their car's battery will degrade over time, but recent data suggests that the initial drop-off in battery capacity is concentrated in the early stages, with a subsequent leveling off.

According to a report by Insideevs, American social media influencer Andy Slye drove his 2026 Tesla Model Y Premium rear-wheel drive for a year, covering approximately 40,000 kilometers, and using a third-party service called Recurrent, estimated that the battery health was still around 91%.

This finding is consistent with research by Voltest, a battery analysis company. Voltest notes that Tesla models with nickel-based batteries, which have a long range, experience the most significant capacity degradation within the first two to three years or within the first 80,000 kilometers. Once this initial period is passed, around 90% of the battery health becomes a stable baseline, with subsequent degradation curves becoming much flatter.

Recurrent analyzed the vehicle's returned energy state, estimated range, mileage, charging records, and temperature data to cross-reference with other models of the same type and draw conclusions. Slye typically charges his car at home using alternating current and only occasionally uses Supercharger fast-charging stations, and his car spent its first year in the mild climate of Kentucky, without prolonged exposure to high temperatures that can accelerate battery degradation.

Slye has performed a full-range test from 100% to 0% and achieved a range of 483 kilometers at highway speeds, exactly matching the estimated value. He calculated that if he only charged to 80%, the actual range would be around 386 kilometers, which is more than sufficient for daily commutes and living. He jokingly said that he didn't like driving that far anyway.

Real-world examples also confirm this trend: a three-year-old high-mileage Model 3 taxi car still has a battery capacity of 88.5%, and a 2015 Model S P85D with nearly 257,000 kilometers on the clock still has a battery health of around 86%.

Experts note that early degradation does not necessarily mean poor performance over the next 100,000 miles (approximately 160,000 kilometers), as battery lifespan is influenced by multiple factors, including driving habits, climate, and charging frequency. However, for most owners, the rule of thumb that 'initial drop-off is fast, but long-term reliability is good' is undoubtedly a reassuring one.

items.title: 川普突下令大砍美韓軍演！稱北韓「不具威脅」、與金正恩關係「良好」
items.title_en: Trump Orders Major Cut in US-South Korea Military Exercises, Says North Korea 'Not a Threat' and Has 'Good Relationship' with Kim Jong-un
paras: 美國總統川普週日（16日）在社群媒體發文表示，他已指示美國國防部大幅削減與南韓舉行的聯合軍事演習，並同時提到南韓曾拒絕參與針對伊朗的相關行動。
根據《路透》報導，在美韓演習預定開始前數小時，川普在社群平台Truth Social發文指出，儘管目前取消整場演習已經太晚，但他對美國先前同意參與這項演習一事「並不高興」。
年度美韓「乙支自由之盾」（Ulchi Freedom Shield）聯合軍事演習定於8月17日至27日舉行，約有1.8萬名南韓軍人參與。
南韓官員上週表示，為因應北韓不斷發展的軍事能力，此次演習預計將納入反制無人機、干擾GPS訊號及應對網路攻擊等作戰行動。
川普在社群媒體貼文中也提到，他與北韓領導人金正恩維持「非常良好的關係」。
川普寫道：「這些演習不僅成本高昂，其中很大一部分費用還由美國承擔（像往常一樣！），更會向一個國家傳遞完全不恰當且帶有敵意的訊號。」
他強調：「自唐納．J．川普擔任總統以來，這個國家（北韓）一直沒有對我們構成威脅，並且始終保持尊重。」
川普也提及南韓對美國與以色列與伊朗之間衝突的立場。
川普寫道：「雖然這多少有些無關（？），但我最近曾詢問南韓總統，他們是否願意加入我們對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國推動的去核化行動，而他們回答：『不用了，謝謝！』」
白宮尚未立即回應外界要求說明川普要求削減美韓軍事演習的進一步詢問。美國國防部也尚未立即作出回應。
平壤一再譴責美韓聯合軍事演習，稱其為準備入侵北韓的行動。南韓與日本軍方表示，北韓上週三從東部沿岸向日本海方向發射一枚彈道飛彈；就在6天前的8月6日，北韓也曾發射一枚類似的短程彈道飛彈。
美國軍方官員表示，曾與俄羅斯並肩參與入侵烏克蘭戰爭的北韓部隊，已從這場衝突中累積實戰經驗，包括日益廣泛運用的無人系統、電子戰及網路作戰等能力。
烏克蘭方面上週表示，俄羅斯對札波羅熱（Zaporizhzhia）一座鋼鐵廠發動彈道飛彈攻擊時，使用了北韓製飛彈，造成7名工人死亡，並迫使該鋼鐵廠暫停生產。俄羅斯在這起攻擊中也使用了「鋯石」（Zircon）高超音速飛彈。
paras_en: US President Trump tweeted on Sunday (16th) that he has instructed the US Department of Defense to significantly reduce the joint military exercises with South Korea, and at the same time mentioned that South Korea had previously refused to participate in related actions against Iran.

According to Reuters, Trump tweeted on the social platform Truth Social a few hours before the scheduled start of the US-South Korea exercise, saying that although the cancellation of the entire exercise is too late, he is 'not happy' about the US's previous agreement to participate in this exercise.
The annual US-South Korea 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' joint military exercise is scheduled to take place from August 17 to 27, with approximately 18,000 South Korean soldiers participating.

South Korean officials said last week that this year's exercise will include countermeasures against unmanned aerial vehicles, jamming GPS signals, and responding to network attacks, among other combat actions, in response to North Korea's continued development of military capabilities.
Trump also mentioned in his social media post that he has a 'very good relationship' with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
Trump wrote: 'These exercises are not only expensive, with a large part of the cost borne by the US (as usual!), but will also send a completely inappropriate and hostile signal to a country.'
He emphasized: 'Since Donald J. Trump took office, this country (North Korea) has never posed a threat to us and has always been respectful.'
Trump also mentioned South Korea's stance on US-Israel-Iran conflicts.

Trump wrote: 'Although this is somewhat irrelevant, I recently asked the South Korean president if they would join our efforts to promote nuclear disarmament against the Islamic Republic of Iran, and they replied: 'No, thank you!' '

The White House has not yet responded to external requests for further explanation of Trump's request to reduce US-South Korea military exercises. The US Department of Defense has also not yet responded.

Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned the US-South Korea joint military exercises, calling them a preparation for an invasion of North Korea. South Korean and Japanese military officials said that North Korea fired a ballistic missile towards the Sea of Japan from its eastern coast last Wednesday; just six days earlier, on August 6, North Korea also fired a similar short-range ballistic missile.

US military officials said that North Korean troops, who had fought alongside Russia in the invasion of Ukraine, have accumulated combat experience, including the increasing use of unmanned systems, electronic warfare, and network warfare capabilities.

Ukraine said last week that Russia used North Korean-made missiles in a ballistic missile attack on a steel plant in Zaporizhzhia, killing seven workers and forcing the plant to suspend production. Russia also used 'Zircon' hypersonic missiles in this attack.

Tensions in the Middle East and rising oil prices are supporting the dollar, but modest U.S. employment and inflation data have weakened the market’s case for a Federal Reserve rate hike next month. Money‑market participants now see about a 35% chance of a September Fed hike, putting pressure on the greenback. In addition, three sources familiar with the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) decision‑making say the BOJ could raise rates as early as September and may adopt a more aggressive pace than the current roughly twice‑a‑year schedule thereafter. This reflects BOJ concerns over inflation pressures from the Middle‑East conflict, strong global demand for artificial intelligence, and the yen’s weakening trend. The market now estimates an almost 80% probability of a September BOJ hike, which would create room for another increase in December and reinforce expectations that the BOJ could raise rates each quarter. Former Japanese Finance Ministry Vice‑Minister Mitsuhiro Furusawa also noted that the yen’s current level is clearly too low, which would raise import costs and hurt the economy, and said Japan could intervene jointly in the currency market at any time, hinting at a faster‑than‑expected rate hike to curb yen depreciation and weigh on the dollar‑yen pair near the 159.53 high.

U.S. officials later reported that July retail sales fell 0.6%, the first decline in nine months, highlighting a slowdown in consumer spending that may prompt economists to lower their Q3 growth forecasts. June corporate inventories were flat month‑over‑month, and the University of Michigan’s August consumer sentiment index slipped to 51.0, ending two months of improvement.
